name: 48_chronos_time_dilation.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @duration 6.0
-- @title Chronos Time Dilation
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 6
--[[ @description
Chronos time dilation. Characters swing into place along circular
pendulum arcs, then idle with a distance-dependent local time flow that
pulses the stroke and rocks each glyph like a clock; the outro rewinds
the arc back out.
]]

local kIntroDuration = 1.0
local kOutroDuration = 0.8
local kStaggerInterval = 0.035
local kMaxOpacity = 1.0
local kTimeDilationStrength = 1.8
local kPendulumFrequency = 0.35
local kArcRadius = 0.14
local kBaseStrokeWidth = 0.015

local kColorTitanium = { r = 0.92, g = 0.94, b = 0.97, a = 1.0 }
local kColorCobaltStroke = { r = 0.28, g = 0.62, b = 0.95, a = 0.85 }

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local time = ctx.time
    local introProgress, outroProgress = mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration)

    -- Dynamic subtle spatial tilt
    ctx.global.yaw = mt.wave(time, 0.12, 0.0) * 3.0
    ctx.global.pitch = mt.wave(time, 0.15, 0.5) * 2.0

    -- Global opacity blending
    ctx.global.opacity = mt.ease.out_cubic(introProgress) * (1.0 - outroProgress)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local time = ctx.time
    local remainingTime = mt.timeline.remaining(ctx)
    local introProgress, outroProgress = mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration)
    local totalChars = ctx.char_count

    -- Ensure bounding box is disabled to remain completely distinct from 50
    ctx.bounding_box.enabled = false

    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local geometry = character.geometry

        -- Relativistic Local Time Dilation based on distance from center
        local dx = geometry.bounds_center_x - 0.5
        local dy = geometry.bounds_center_y - 0.5
        local distFromCenter = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
        local localTime = time * (1.0 + (distFromCenter - 0.2) * kTimeDilationStrength)

        -- 1. Intro: Pendulum Arc Release
        local charIntroRaw = mt.clamp((localTime - (index - 1) * kStaggerInterval) / 0.45, 0.0, 1.0)
        local charIntroEased = mt.ease.out_cubic(charIntroRaw)
        local introRotation = (1.0 - charIntroEased) * -50.0
        local introArcX = (1.0 - charIntroEased) * -0.15
        local introArcY = (1.0 - charIntroEased) * -0.08

        -- 2. Outro: Pendulum Arc Rewind (Seamless normalized window)
        local staggerRatio = 0.03
        local charOutroWindowStart = (index - 1) * staggerRatio
        local charOutroWindowSpan = math.max(0.3, 1.0 - (totalChars - 1) * staggerRatio)
        local charOutroRaw = mt.clamp((outroProgress - charOutroWindowStart) / charOutroWindowSpan, 0.0, 1.0)
        local charOutroEased = mt.ease.in_cubic(charOutroRaw)
        local outroRotation = charOutroEased * 50.0
        local outroArcX = charOutroEased * 0.15
        local outroArcY = charOutroEased * -0.08

        -- 3. Idle: Pendulum Oscillation & Breathing Time Dilation Stroke
        local pendulumPhase = index * 0.35
        local pendulumAngle = math.sin(localTime * kPendulumFrequency * math.pi * 2.0 + pendulumPhase) * 0.18
        local idleArcX = math.sin(pendulumAngle) * kArcRadius
        local idleArcY = (1.0 - math.cos(pendulumAngle)) * kArcRadius * 0.5

        -- Dynamic localized stroke pulsation symbolizing time distortion
        local strokePulse = (mt.wave(localTime * 1.2, 0.6, distFromCenter * 4.0) * 0.5 + 0.5) * 0.015
        character.stroke.use = true
        character.stroke.width = kBaseStrokeWidth + strokePulse
        character.stroke.color = kColorCobaltStroke

        -- Composite transformations (Circular Arc + Rotation)
        character.offset_x = 0.5 + introArcX + outroArcX + idleArcX
        character.offset_y = 0.5 + introArcY + outroArcY + idleArcY
        character.rotation = introRotation + outroRotation + math.deg(pendulumAngle)
        character.pivot_y = 0.8 -- Pivot anchored near bottom for natural pendulum swing
        character.opacity = mt.clamp(charIntroEased * (1.0 - charOutroEased), 0.0, kMaxOpacity)

        character.fill.use = true
        character.fill.color = kColorTitanium
    end
end
description:
Chronos time dilation. Characters swing into place along circular
pendulum arcs, then idle with a distance-dependent local time flow that
pulses the stroke and rocks each glyph like a clock; the outro rewinds
the arc back out.
title: Chronos Time Dilation
author: Mug

name: 49_antigravity_singularity.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @duration 5.0
-- @required 3d
-- @recommend bg #040509
-- @title Antigravity Singularity
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 6
--[[ @description
Quantum zero-G field. Parts spring out of a central singularity, then
hang in deep-space platinum with cyan quantum flicker and a weightless
multi-octave drift; the outro deconstructs the grid into 3D space.
]]

local kIntroDuration = 1.2
local kOutroDuration = 0.9
local kStaggerInterval = 0.03
local kSpringFrequency = 2.2
local kSpringDamping = 3.5
local kZeroGAmplitude = 0.018
local kMaxOpacity = 1.0

local kColorDeepSpace = { r = 0.88, g = 0.90, b = 0.94, a = 1.0 }
local kColorCyanTint = { r = 0.25, g = 0.85, b = 0.95, a = 1.0 }

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local time = ctx.time
    local introProgress, outroProgress = mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration)

    -- Gentle anti-gravitational spatial posture rotation
    ctx.global.rotation = mt.wave(time, 0.12, 0.0) * 1.5
    ctx.global.yaw = mt.wave(time, 0.15, 0.5) * 4.0
    ctx.global.pitch = mt.wave(time, 0.18, 1.0) * 2.5

    -- Global opacity blending
    ctx.global.opacity = mt.ease.out_cubic(introProgress) * (1.0 - outroProgress)
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local time = ctx.time
    local remainingTime = mt.timeline.remaining(ctx)
    local introProgress, outroProgress = mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration)
    local instanceSeed = ctx.meta.instance_seed
    local totalParts = ctx.part_count

    for index, part in mt.each_part(ctx) do
        local geometry = part.geometry

        -- 1. Intro: Physical spring fluid transition from singularity
        local staggerTime = (index - 1) * kStaggerInterval
        local introTime = time - staggerTime
        local introProgressPart = mt.clamp(introTime / 0.5, 0.0, 1.0)
        local springSettle = mt.spring(introTime, kSpringFrequency, kSpringDamping)

        local dx = 0.5 - geometry.canvas_center_x
        local dy = 0.5 - geometry.canvas_center_y
        local introOffsetX = 0.5 + dx * springSettle
        local introOffsetY = 0.5 + dy * springSettle
        local introZ = springSettle * 1.5
        local introScale = mt.lerp(0.1, 1.0, mt.ease.out_expo(introProgressPart))

        -- 2. Outro: Grid Deconstruction (seamless normalized window)
        local staggerRatio = 0.025
        local partOutroWindowStart = (index - 1) * staggerRatio
        local partOutroWindowSpan = math.max(0.3, 1.0 - (totalParts - 1) * staggerRatio)
        local partOutroRaw = mt.clamp((outroProgress - partOutroWindowStart) / partOutroWindowSpan, 0.0, 1.0)
        local partOutroEased = mt.ease.in_cubic(partOutroRaw)

        local gridDirection = (index % 2 == 0) and 1.0 or -1.0
        local outroOffsetX = partOutroEased * 0.1 * gridDirection
        local outroZ = partOutroEased * -0.8
        local outroYaw = partOutroEased * 90.0 * gridDirection

        -- 3. Idle: Zero-G Multi-octave Drift & Quantum Spectrum
        local wiggleX = mt.wiggle(time, 0.35, kZeroGAmplitude, 2, instanceSeed + index)
        local wiggleY = mt.wiggle(time, 0.28, kZeroGAmplitude * 1.2, 2, instanceSeed + index * 2)
        local driftZ = mt.wave(time, 0.3, index * 0.2) * 0.02

        local distFromCenter = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
        local rippleHue = mt.wrap(time * 0.2 + distFromCenter * 1.5, 0.0, 1.0)
        local oklchColor = mt.color.from_oklch(0.78, 0.18, rippleHue, 1.0)
        local quantumPulse = (mt.wave(time * 1.5, 0.6, distFromCenter * 3.0) * 0.5 + 0.5) * 0.3
        local finalColor = mt.color.lerp(kColorDeepSpace, oklchColor, quantumPulse)

        -- Composite transform
        part.offset_x = introOffsetX + outroOffsetX + wiggleX
        part.offset_y = introOffsetY + wiggleY
        part.z = introZ + outroZ + driftZ
        part.yaw = outroYaw
        part.scale = introScale * (1.0 - partOutroEased * 0.4)
        part.opacity = mt.clamp(introProgressPart * (1.0 - partOutroEased), 0.0, kMaxOpacity)

        part.fill.use = true
        part.fill.color = finalColor
    end
end
description:
Quantum zero-G field. Parts spring out of a central singularity, then
hang in deep-space platinum with cyan quantum flicker and a weightless
multi-octave drift; the outro deconstructs the grid into 3D space.
title: Antigravity Singularity
author: Mug

name: 50_architectural_kinetic_typography.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @duration 4.0
-- @title Architectural Kinetic Typography
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 6
--[[ @description
Architectural kinetic typography. A minimalist monochrome title: wide
tracking collapses into precise grid alignment with a sharp bounding
box, breathes under a subtle camera dolly, then slides cleanly away.
]]

local kIntroDuration = 1.0
local kOutroDuration = 0.8
local kWideTrackingStart = 0.45
local kNormalTracking = 0.0
local kMaxOpacity = 1.0
local kBoxMargin = 120.0
local kBoxWidth = 12.0
local kBoxCornerRadius = 4.0
local kCameraZoomMin = 1.0
local kCameraZoomMax = 1.05
local kBreathFrequency = 0.3

local kColorTextNormal = { r = 0.92, g = 0.93, b = 0.95, a = 1.0 }
local kColorBoxStroke = { r = 0.85, g = 0.86, b = 0.88, a = 0.85 }
local kColorBoxFill = { r = 0.12, g = 0.13, b = 0.16, a = 0.4 }

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local time = ctx.time
    local introProgress, outroProgress = mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration)

    -- Dynamic wide tracking collapse to normal grid pitch
    local introTrackingProgress = mt.ease.out_expo(introProgress)
    local introTracking = mt.lerp(kWideTrackingStart, kNormalTracking, introTrackingProgress)
    local outroTracking = outroProgress * 0.15
    local breathTracking = mt.wave(time, kBreathFrequency, 0.0) * 0.015
    ctx.global.tracking = introTracking + outroTracking + breathTracking

    -- Subtle camera dolly for cinematic depth
    local cameraZoom = mt.lerp(kCameraZoomMin, kCameraZoomMax, mt.ease.in_out_sine(introProgress))
    ctx.camera.zoom = cameraZoom + mt.wave(time, 0.25, 0.0) * 0.01

    -- Smooth global opacity control
    local introOpacity = mt.clamp(introProgress * 2.0, 0.0, kMaxOpacity)
    local outroOpacity = 1.0 - outroProgress
    ctx.global.opacity = introOpacity * outroOpacity
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local time = ctx.time
    local remainingTime = mt.timeline.remaining(ctx)
    local introProgress, outroProgress = mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration)

    -- Architectural Bounding Box configuration
    ctx.bounding_box.enabled = true
    ctx.bounding_box.width = kBoxWidth
    ctx.bounding_box.color = kColorBoxStroke
    ctx.bounding_box.fill_enabled = true
    ctx.bounding_box.fill_color = kColorBoxFill
    ctx.bounding_box.fill_opacity = 0.4 * (1.0 - outroProgress)
    ctx.bounding_box.margin_x = kBoxMargin * (0.8 + 0.2 * mt.ease.out_cubic(introProgress))
    ctx.bounding_box.margin_y = kBoxMargin * 0.6
    ctx.bounding_box.corner_radius = kBoxCornerRadius
    ctx.bounding_box.draw_top = true
    ctx.bounding_box.draw_bottom = true
    ctx.bounding_box.draw_left = true
    ctx.bounding_box.draw_right = true

    -- Character-level linear slide and smooth staggered outro
    local totalChars = ctx.char_count
    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local staggerRatio = 0.04

        -- Intro character vertical slide (smooth drop-in)
        local charIntroRaw = mt.clamp((time - (index - 1) * 0.03) / 0.35, 0.0, 1.0)
        local charIntroEased = mt.ease.out_cubic(charIntroRaw)
        local introOffsetY = (1.0 - charIntroEased) * -0.06

        -- Outro character horizontal slide (seamless staggered motion anchored to outroProgress)
        -- Normalizing window so all characters finish smoothly before clip end without sudden stop
        local charOutroWindowStart = (index - 1) * staggerRatio
        local charOutroWindowSpan = math.max(0.3, 1.0 - (totalChars - 1) * staggerRatio)
        local charOutroRaw = mt.clamp((outroProgress - charOutroWindowStart) / charOutroWindowSpan, 0.0, 1.0)
        local charOutroEased = mt.ease.in_cubic(charOutroRaw)
        local outroOffsetX = charOutroEased * 0.12

        character.offset_y = 0.5 + introOffsetY
        character.offset_x = 0.5 + outroOffsetX
        character.opacity = charIntroEased * (1.0 - charOutroEased)

        character.fill.use = true
        character.fill.color = kColorTextNormal
    end
end
description:
Architectural kinetic typography. A minimalist monochrome title: wide
tracking collapses into precise grid alignment with a sharp bounding
box, breathes under a subtle camera dolly, then slides cleanly away.
title: Architectural Kinetic Typography
author: Mug

name: 51_ripple_echo.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @duration 5.5
-- @title Ripple Echo
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 6
--[[ @description
Concentric ripple echo. A ring-shaped shockwave expands from the text's
center, lifting and flashing each character as the front reaches it, so
the wave travels through multi-line layouts as a circle. The outro
reverses the ring and glyphs sink back to stillness from the outside in.
]]

local kIntroDuration = 1.1 -- seconds for the first wake front to finish
local kOutroDuration = 0.85 -- seconds
local kFallbackClipLength = 5.5 -- seconds, used when ctx.timeline is unavailable
local kWakeRadius = 0.55 -- canvas units the intro front travels past center
local kWaveSpeed = 0.42 -- canvas units per second of the idle harmonic
local kWaveWidth = 0.07 -- half-width of the ring's gaussian envelope
local kLiftHeight = 0.045 -- canvas-height fraction at peak crest
local kScalePop = 0.22 -- extra scale at the crest
local kIdleAmplitude = 0.55 -- relative strength of the continuous harmonic
local kBaseHue = 0.55 -- cyan resting hue
local kFlashHue = 0.08 -- warm flash hue at the crest

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)

    -- Intro front starts collapsed at the center and expands outward.
    local introFront = mt.ease.out_cubic(introAmount) * kWakeRadius
    -- Idle harmonic keeps a slow ring pinging forever after the wake.
    local idleFront = mt.cycle(ctx.time, kWakeRadius / kWaveSpeed) * kWakeRadius
    -- Outro front collapses from the outside back to the center.
    local outroFront = (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outroAmount)) * kWakeRadius

    for _, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local geometry = character.geometry
        local radius = mt.layout.radial_distance(
            ctx,
            geometry.bounds_center_x,
            geometry.bounds_center_y
        )

        local introCrest = mt.falloff(radius - introFront, kWaveWidth)
        local idleCrest =
            mt.falloff(radius - idleFront, kWaveWidth) * kIdleAmplitude * introAmount
        local outroCrest = mt.falloff(radius - outroFront, kWaveWidth) * outroAmount

        -- Characters "wake" once the intro front has passed them, and
        -- fall back asleep as the outro front reclaims them from outside.
        local woken = mt.smoothstep(0.0, kWaveWidth * 1.5, introFront - radius)
        local asleep = mt.smoothstep(0.0, kWaveWidth * 1.5, radius - outroFront)
        local presence = woken * (1.0 - asleep * outroAmount)

        local crest = introCrest + idleCrest + outroCrest
        local lift = crest * kLiftHeight
        -- Outro also gently sinks the whole line so the exit is not only a
        -- ring fade but a physical collapse.
        local sink = outroAmount * 0.03

        character.offset_y = 0.5 + lift - sink
        character.scale = 1.0 + crest * kScalePop
        character.opacity = mt.saturate(presence * 1.15) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_quad(outroAmount) * 0.35)

        local flash = mt.saturate(introCrest + idleCrest * 0.6)
        local restingColor = mt.color.from_hsv(kBaseHue, 0.35, 0.92, 1.0)
        local flashColor = mt.color.from_hsv(kFlashHue, 0.75, 1.0, 1.0)
        character.fill.use = true
        character.fill.color = mt.color.lerp(restingColor, flashColor, flash)
    end
end
description:
Concentric ripple echo. A ring-shaped shockwave expands from the text's
center, lifting and flashing each character as the front reaches it, so
the wave travels through multi-line layouts as a circle. The outro
reverses the ring and glyphs sink back to stillness from the outside in.
title: Ripple Echo
author: Mug

name: 52_curious_lean.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @duration 6.0
-- @required 3d
-- @title Curious Lean
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 6
--[[ @description
Curious lean-in (3D). Glyphs peer in from the wings with a skeptical
side-tilt, keep thinking through micro head-tilts and a slow yaw drift
without ever settling, then spin on their heel and shrug off screen.
]]

local kIntroDuration = 1.15
local kOutroDuration = 0.95
local kFallbackClipLength = 6.0
local kStaggerAmount = 0.5
local kWingDistance = 0.28 -- canvas fraction slid in from the side
local kPeekDrop = 0.04 -- slight drop while peeking in
local kIntroTiltDegrees = 18.0
local kSteadyTiltDegrees = 5.5
local kSteadyTiltFrequency = 0.55 -- Hz, thinking nod cadence
local kSteadyYawDegrees = 7.0
local kSteadyPulse = 0.06 -- scale breath while thinking
local kOutroSpinDegrees = 55.0
local kOutroKick = 0.34 -- canvas fraction of the exit shove
local kAmberHue = 0.08
local kSteelHue = 0.58

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)
    local steadyAmount = mt.ease.out_cubic(introAmount) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outroAmount))

    -- Room re-read: slow global yaw only while thinking.
    ctx.global.yaw = mt.wave(ctx.time, 0.11, 0.0) * kSteadyYawDegrees * steadyAmount
    ctx.global.pitch = mt.wave(ctx.time, 0.09, 1.2) * 2.0 * steadyAmount
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)
    local seed = ctx.meta.instance_seed

    for index, character, info in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local order = info.progress

        -- Per-character block weights (each finishes before clip end).
        local introRaw = mt.stagger_progress(introAmount, order, kStaggerAmount)
        local outroRaw = mt.stagger_progress(outroAmount, order, kStaggerAmount)
        local introEased = mt.ease.out_back(introRaw)
        local outroEased = mt.ease.in_back(outroRaw)
        local introClamped = mt.saturate(introEased)
        local steadyWeight = introClamped * (1.0 - outroEased)

        -- Wing side alternates so the lean-in reads as a crowd, not a march.
        local wingSign = ((index % 2) == 0) and 1.0 or -1.0
        local personality = mt.random_range(seed, index, 0.75, 1.25)

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 1. Intro: side-eye peek from the wings
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local introRemain = 1.0 - introClamped
        local introOffsetX = wingSign * kWingDistance * introRemain * personality
        local introOffsetY = -kPeekDrop * introRemain
        local introRotation = -wingSign * kIntroTiltDegrees * introRemain
        local introOpacity = mt.saturate(introRaw * 2.2)

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 2. Steady: thinking tilts + sly amber pulse (never still)
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local thinkPhase = ctx.time * kSteadyTiltFrequency * math.pi * 2.0
            + index * 0.85
            + personality
        local thinkTilt = math.sin(thinkPhase) * kSteadyTiltDegrees * steadyWeight * personality
        local thinkNod = math.sin(thinkPhase * 0.5 + 0.4) * 0.008 * steadyWeight
        local thinkPulse = 1.0
            + math.sin(thinkPhase * 1.3) * kSteadyPulse * steadyWeight
        local amberMix = (math.sin(thinkPhase * 0.7) * 0.5 + 0.5) * steadyWeight * 0.55

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 3. Outro: heel-spin shrug and opposite-wing exit
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local outroOffsetX = -wingSign * kOutroKick * outroEased * personality
        local outroOffsetY = kPeekDrop * 0.6 * outroEased
        local outroRotation = wingSign * kOutroSpinDegrees * outroEased
        local wink = 1.0 + math.sin(outroEased * math.pi) * 0.18
        local outroFade = 1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outroRaw)

        character.offset_x = 0.5 + introOffsetX + outroOffsetX
        character.offset_y = 0.5 + introOffsetY + thinkNod + outroOffsetY
        character.rotation = introRotation + thinkTilt + outroRotation
        character.scale = thinkPulse * wink
        character.opacity = introOpacity * outroFade

        local steel = mt.color.from_hsv(kSteelHue, 0.18, 0.92, 1.0)
        local amber = mt.color.from_hsv(kAmberHue, 0.72, 1.0, 1.0)
        character.fill.use = true
        character.fill.color = mt.color.lerp(steel, amber, amberMix)
    end
end
description:
Curious lean-in (3D). Glyphs peer in from the wings with a skeptical
side-tilt, keep thinking through micro head-tilts and a slow yaw drift
without ever settling, then spin on their heel and shrug off screen.
title: Curious Lean
author: Mug

name: 53_neural_spark.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @duration 6.0
-- @title Neural Spark
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 6
--[[ @description
Neural spark: chaos to answer to punchline. Glyphs scatter as noisy
half-formed thoughts and snap onto the baseline in one decisive click,
idle with a hue current and voltage-breathing strokes, then detonate
into high-energy fragments instead of fading politely.
]]

local kIntroDuration = 1.25
local kOutroDuration = 1.0
local kFallbackClipLength = 6.0
local kStaggerAmount = 0.48
local kChaosMin = 0.14
local kChaosMax = 0.38
local kChaosSpin = 140.0
local kSpringFrequency = 3.6
local kSpringDamping = 3.4
local kTokenHop = 0.012 -- canvas fraction of steady token ticks
local kTokenFrequency = 1.4 -- Hz base for token hops
local kStrokeBase = 0.01
local kStrokePulse = 0.012
local kPunchDistance = 0.42
local kPunchSpin = 200.0
local kPunchScale = 0.45

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)
    local steadyAmount = mt.ease.out_cubic(introAmount) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outroAmount))

    -- Thought-current tracking: slightly tight while answering, looser
    -- in chaos / punchline so fragments can breathe.
    ctx.global.tracking = mt.lerp(0.06, 0.0, steadyAmount)
    ctx.global.shadow.enabled = true
    ctx.global.shadow.distance = 1.0 + (1.0 - steadyAmount) * 0.8
    ctx.global.shadow.angle = 110.0
    ctx.global.shadow.color = { r = 0.05, g = 0.15, b = 0.35, a = 0.55 }
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)
    local characterCount = math.max(ctx.char_count, 1)
    local seed = ctx.meta.instance_seed
    local time = ctx.time

    for index, character, info in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local order = info.progress

        local introRaw = mt.stagger_progress(introAmount, order, kStaggerAmount)
        local outroRaw = mt.stagger_progress(outroAmount, order, kStaggerAmount)
        local outroEased = mt.ease.in_cubic(outroRaw)

        -- Spring commit: scatterWeight 1 = pure chaos, 0 = locked answer.
        local springTime = introRaw * 1.2
        local springSettle = mt.spring(springTime, kSpringFrequency, kSpringDamping)
        local scatterWeight = mt.lerp(1.0, springSettle, mt.saturate(introRaw * 10.0))
        local answerWeight = mt.saturate(1.0 - scatterWeight) * (1.0 - outroEased)
        local steadyWeight = answerWeight

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 1. Intro: noisy half-thoughts → decisive spring commit
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local chaosAngle = mt.random_range(seed, index, 0.0, math.pi * 2.0)
        local chaosDistance =
            mt.random_range(seed, index + characterCount, kChaosMin, kChaosMax)
        local chaosSpin =
            mt.random_range(seed, index + characterCount * 2, -kChaosSpin, kChaosSpin)
        local introOffsetX = math.cos(chaosAngle) * chaosDistance * scatterWeight
        local introOffsetY = math.sin(chaosAngle) * chaosDistance * scatterWeight
        local introRotation = chaosSpin * scatterWeight
        -- Flicker while uncommitted, solid once the spring locks.
        local chaosFlicker = 0.35
            + 0.65 * mt.random_range(seed + math.floor(time * 18.0), index, 0.0, 1.0)
        local introOpacity = mt.lerp(chaosFlicker, 1.0, mt.saturate(1.0 - scatterWeight))

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 2. Steady: voltage current + per-glyph token hops
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local tokenPhase = time * kTokenFrequency * math.pi * 2.0
            + order * math.pi * 1.7
            + mt.random_range(seed, index + 7, 0.0, math.pi)
        -- Soft square-ish hop: mostly down, brief uptick = "token emit".
        local tokenWave = math.max(0.0, math.sin(tokenPhase))
        local tokenHop = tokenWave * tokenWave * kTokenHop * steadyWeight
        local voltage = (mt.wave(time, 0.85, order * 2.4) * 0.5 + 0.5) * steadyWeight
        local currentHue = mt.wrap(0.52 + order * 0.22 + time * 0.08, 0.0, 1.0)

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 3. Outro: punchline detonation (new rays, not intro reverse)
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local punchAngle =
            mt.random_range(seed, index + characterCount * 3, 0.0, math.pi * 2.0)
        local punchSpin =
            mt.random_range(seed, index + characterCount * 4, -kPunchSpin, kPunchSpin)
        local punchOffsetX = math.cos(punchAngle) * kPunchDistance * outroEased
        local punchOffsetY = math.sin(punchAngle) * kPunchDistance * outroEased
        local punchRotation = punchSpin * outroEased
        local punchScale = 1.0 + kPunchScale * outroEased
        local punchFade = 1.0 - mt.ease.in_quad(outroRaw)

        character.offset_x = 0.5 + introOffsetX + punchOffsetX
        character.offset_y = 0.5 + introOffsetY + tokenHop + punchOffsetY
        character.rotation = introRotation + punchRotation
        character.scale = punchScale
        character.opacity = introOpacity * punchFade

        -- Voltage palette: ice → electric cyan/violet while answering,
        -- blows toward hot white on the punchline.
        local answerColor = mt.color.from_oklch(0.78 + voltage * 0.1, 0.16 + voltage * 0.08, currentHue, 1.0)
        local chaosColor = mt.color.from_oklch(0.55, 0.04, 0.6, 1.0)
        local punchColor = { r = 1.0, g = 0.95, b = 0.88, a = 1.0 }
        local filled = mt.color.lerp(chaosColor, answerColor, answerWeight)
        character.fill.use = true
        character.fill.color = mt.color.lerp(filled, punchColor, outroEased)

        character.stroke.use = true
        character.stroke.width = kStrokeBase + kStrokePulse * voltage
        character.stroke.color = mt.color.from_oklch(0.7, 0.14, currentHue, 0.35 + voltage * 0.5)
        character.stroke.gap = 0.0

        character.shadow.use = true
        character.shadow.color = {
            r = 0.1,
            g = 0.35,
            b = 0.9,
            a = 0.1 + 0.35 * answerWeight,
        }
    end
end
description:
Neural spark: chaos to answer to punchline. Glyphs scatter as noisy
half-formed thoughts and snap onto the baseline in one decisive click,
idle with a hue current and voltage-breathing strokes, then detonate
into high-energy fragments instead of fading politely.
title: Neural Spark
author: Mug

name: 54_comet_arc.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @duration 6.0
-- @title Comet Arc
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 6
--[[ @description
Comet arc path. Each character streaks in along its own Bezier curve
with its rotation following the path tangent, patrols a small
figure-eight while it holds, then flings off-frame along a different arc.
]]

local kIntroDuration = 1.2
local kOutroDuration = 0.95
local kFallbackClipLength = 6.0
local kStaggerAmount = 0.55
local kSteadyRadius = 0.018 -- figure-eight half-size in offset space
local kSteadyPeriod = 2.8 -- seconds per full idle loop
local kTrailHue = 0.55

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)
    local characterCount = math.max(ctx.char_count, 1)
    local seed = ctx.meta.instance_seed

    for index, character, info in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local order = info.progress

        local introRaw = mt.stagger_progress(introAmount, order, kStaggerAmount)
        local outroRaw = mt.stagger_progress(outroAmount, order, kStaggerAmount)
        local introEased = mt.ease.out_cubic(introRaw)
        local outroEased = mt.ease.in_cubic(outroRaw)

        -- Per-glyph wing and height so the cascade fans out.
        local wingSign = ((index % 2) == 0) and 1.0 or -1.0
        local entryLift = mt.random_range(seed, index, 0.12, 0.22)
        local entrySide = wingSign * mt.random_range(seed, index + characterCount, 0.18, 0.32)
        local exitSide = -wingSign * mt.random_range(seed, index + characterCount * 2, 0.22, 0.38)
        local exitDrop = mt.random_range(seed, index + characterCount * 3, -0.08, 0.12)

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 1. Intro: Bezier comet arrival (path progress 0 → 1)
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local introP0 = { x = 0.5 + entrySide, y = 0.5 + entryLift }
        local introP1 = { x = 0.5 + entrySide * 0.35, y = 0.5 + entryLift * 0.15 }
        local introP2 = { x = 0.5 - wingSign * 0.04, y = 0.5 - 0.02 }
        local introP3 = { x = 0.5, y = 0.5 }
        local introX, introY, introTangentX, introTangentY =
            mt.path.bezier(introP0, introP1, introP2, introP3, introEased)
        local introRotation = math.deg(math.atan(introTangentY, introTangentX))

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 2. Steady: Catmull-Rom figure-eight around the seat
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local loopProgress = mt.cycle(ctx.time + order * 0.35, kSteadyPeriod)
        local idleWaypoints = {
            { x = 0.5, y = 0.5 },
            { x = 0.5 + kSteadyRadius, y = 0.5 + kSteadyRadius * 0.55 },
            { x = 0.5, y = 0.5 },
            { x = 0.5 - kSteadyRadius, y = 0.5 - kSteadyRadius * 0.55 },
            { x = 0.5, y = 0.5 },
        }
        local idleX, idleY, idleTangentX, idleTangentY =
            mt.path.catmull_rom(idleWaypoints, loopProgress)
        local idleRotation = math.deg(math.atan(idleTangentY, idleTangentX)) * 0.35

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 3. Outro: different Bezier exit (not intro reversed)
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local outroP0 = { x = 0.5, y = 0.5 }
        local outroP1 = { x = 0.5 + exitSide * 0.25, y = 0.5 + 0.06 }
        local outroP2 = { x = 0.5 + exitSide * 0.7, y = 0.5 + exitDrop * 0.4 }
        local outroP3 = { x = 0.5 + exitSide, y = 0.5 + exitDrop }
        local outroX, outroY, outroTangentX, outroTangentY =
            mt.path.bezier(outroP0, outroP1, outroP2, outroP3, outroEased)
        local outroRotation = math.deg(math.atan(outroTangentY, outroTangentX))

        -- Pick the active block pose (do not cross-lerp path samples —
        -- that would leave the curve). Outro wins, then intro, else idle.
        local pathX = idleX
        local pathY = idleY
        local rotation = idleRotation
        if outroEased > 0.0 then
            pathX = outroX
            pathY = outroY
            rotation = outroRotation
        elseif introEased < 1.0 then
            pathX = introX
            pathY = introY
            rotation = introRotation
        end

        character.offset_x = pathX
        character.offset_y = pathY
        character.rotation = rotation
        character.opacity = mt.saturate(introRaw * 2.5) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_quad(outroRaw))
        character.scale = 1.0 + (1.0 - introEased) * 0.2 + outroEased * 0.15

        -- Cool comet trail palette; brighter while still airborne on the arc.
        local airAmount = (1.0 - introEased) + outroEased
        local baseColor = mt.color.from_hsv(kTrailHue + order * 0.08, 0.35, 0.88, 1.0)
        local hotColor = mt.color.from_hsv(kTrailHue - 0.08, 0.55, 1.0, 1.0)
        character.fill.use = true
        character.fill.color = mt.color.lerp(baseColor, hotColor, mt.saturate(airAmount))
    end
end
description:
Comet arc path. Each character streaks in along its own Bezier curve
with its rotation following the path tangent, patrols a small
figure-eight while it holds, then flings off-frame along a different arc.
title: Comet Arc
author: Mug

name: 55_storyboard_keys.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @duration 6.0
-- @title Storyboard Keys
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 6
--[[ @description
Storyboard keyframes. Multi-beat choreography written as key tables
instead of hand-rolled segment math: a drop-bounce-settle entrance, a
short looping hold phrase, and a separate crouch-launch-fade exit.
]]

local kIntroDuration = 1.25
local kOutroDuration = 1.0
local kFallbackClipLength = 6.0
local kStaggerSeconds = 0.07 -- real-time cascade between characters
local kSteadyLoopSeconds = 1.6

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)

    for index, character, info in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local order = info.progress
        -- Real-second stagger (not progress-scaled) so typing speed stays
        -- constant when the clip is stretched.
        local localTime = ctx.time - (index - 1) * kStaggerSeconds

        local introRaw = mt.stagger_progress(introAmount, order, 0.45)
        local outroRaw = mt.stagger_progress(outroAmount, 1.0 - order, 0.4)
        local introEased = mt.ease.out_cubic(introRaw)
        local outroEased = mt.ease.in_cubic(outroRaw)
        local steadyWeight = introEased * (1.0 - outroEased)

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 1. Intro keys: drop → bounce → settle (localTime seconds)
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local introOffsetY = mt.keyframes({
            { t = 0.0, v = 0.18 },
            { t = 0.4, v = 0.0, ease = "out_bounce" },
            { t = 0.85, v = 0.0 },
        }, localTime)
        local introScale = mt.keyframes({
            { t = 0.0, v = 0.55 },
            { t = 0.35, v = 1.08, ease = "out_back" },
            { t = 0.7, v = 1.0, ease = "out_cubic" },
        }, localTime)
        local introRotation = mt.keyframes({
            { t = 0.0, v = -18.0 },
            { t = 0.45, v = 4.0, ease = "out_cubic" },
            { t = 0.8, v = 0.0, ease = "in_out_sine" },
        }, localTime)
        local introColor = mt.keyframes({
            { t = 0.0, v = { r = 0.35, g = 0.4, b = 0.55, a = 1.0 } },
            { t = 0.5, v = { r = 1.0, g = 0.72, b = 0.35, a = 1.0 }, ease = "out_cubic" },
            { t = 0.95, v = { r = 0.92, g = 0.93, b = 0.96, a = 1.0 }, ease = "in_out_sine" },
        }, localTime)

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 2. Steady keys: looping phrase on a cycled clock
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local steadyClock = mt.cycle(ctx.time + order * 0.25, kSteadyLoopSeconds) * kSteadyLoopSeconds
        local steadyOffsetY = mt.keyframes({
            { t = 0.0, v = 0.0 },
            { t = 0.4, v = 0.012, ease = "in_out_sine" },
            { t = 0.9, v = -0.006, ease = "in_out_sine" },
            { t = kSteadyLoopSeconds, v = 0.0, ease = "in_out_sine" },
        }, steadyClock)
        local steadyRotation = mt.keyframes({
            { t = 0.0, v = 0.0 },
            { t = 0.5, v = 3.5, ease = "in_out_sine" },
            { t = kSteadyLoopSeconds, v = 0.0, ease = "in_out_sine" },
        }, steadyClock)
        local steadyScale = mt.keyframes({
            { t = 0.0, v = 1.0 },
            { t = 0.55, v = 1.04, ease = "in_out_sine" },
            { t = kSteadyLoopSeconds, v = 1.0, ease = "in_out_sine" },
        }, steadyClock)
        local steadyColor = mt.keyframes({
            { t = 0.0, v = { r = 0.92, g = 0.93, b = 0.96, a = 1.0 } },
            { t = 0.7, v = { r = 0.55, g = 0.78, b = 1.0, a = 1.0 }, ease = "in_out_sine" },
            { t = kSteadyLoopSeconds, v = { r = 0.92, g = 0.93, b = 0.96, a = 1.0 }, ease = "in_out_sine" },
        }, steadyClock)

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 3. Outro keys: crouch → launch (outro-local seconds)
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- Map outroRaw 0–1 onto a fixed 0–1 second key window so the
        -- phrase always completes at clip end regardless of clip length.
        local outroClock = outroEased * 1.0
        local outroOffsetY = mt.keyframes({
            { t = 0.0, v = 0.0 },
            { t = 0.25, v = -0.02, ease = "in_cubic" },
            { t = 1.0, v = 0.28, ease = "in_back" },
        }, outroClock)
        local outroScale = mt.keyframes({
            { t = 0.0, v = 1.0 },
            { t = 0.3, v = 0.88, ease = "in_cubic" },
            { t = 1.0, v = 1.25, ease = "in_cubic" },
        }, outroClock)
        local outroRotation = mt.keyframes({
            { t = 0.0, v = 0.0 },
            { t = 1.0, v = 22.0 * (((index % 2) == 0) and 1.0 or -1.0), ease = "in_cubic" },
        }, outroClock)
        local outroColor = mt.keyframes({
            { t = 0.0, v = { r = 0.92, g = 0.93, b = 0.96, a = 1.0 } },
            { t = 0.45, v = { r = 0.75, g = 0.55, b = 1.0, a = 1.0 }, ease = "out_cubic" },
            { t = 1.0, v = { r = 0.25, g = 0.3, b = 0.55, a = 1.0 }, ease = "in_cubic" },
        }, outroClock)

        -- Block composite: intro pose → steady phrase → outro launch.
        local offsetY = introOffsetY
        local scale = introScale
        local rotation = introRotation
        local fillColor = introColor

        offsetY = mt.lerp(offsetY, steadyOffsetY, steadyWeight)
        scale = mt.lerp(scale, steadyScale, steadyWeight)
        rotation = mt.lerp(rotation, steadyRotation, steadyWeight)
        fillColor = mt.color.lerp(fillColor, steadyColor, steadyWeight)

        offsetY = mt.lerp(offsetY, outroOffsetY, outroEased)
        scale = mt.lerp(scale, outroScale, outroEased)
        rotation = mt.lerp(rotation, outroRotation, outroEased)
        fillColor = mt.color.lerp(fillColor, outroColor, outroEased)

        character.offset_y = 0.5 + offsetY
        character.offset_x = 0.5
        character.scale = scale
        character.rotation = rotation
        character.opacity = mt.saturate(introRaw * 3.0) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_quad(outroRaw))

        character.fill.use = true
        character.fill.color = fillColor
    end
end
description:
Storyboard keyframes. Multi-beat choreography written as key tables
instead of hand-rolled segment math: a drop-bounce-settle entrance, a
short looping hold phrase, and a separate crouch-launch-fade exit.
title: Storyboard Keys
author: Mug

name: 56_inspector_knobs.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @duration 6.0
-- @title Inspector Knobs
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 6
--[[ @description
Inspector knobs hack: host sliders repurposed as script coefficients.
The animation itself is a staggered pop-in, a wave and bob hold, and a
reverse cascade exit -- but Tracking, Rotation, Scale and Line spacing
tune its stagger, sway, travel and bob instead of posing the text.

Knob map:
  Tracking      -> cascade stagger (also letter-spacing; try 0.2 ... 0.4)
  Rotation      -> sway amplitude degrees (try 0 ... 25)
  Scale         -> intro travel only (size forced to 1; try 0.6 ... 1.6)
  Line spacing  -> idle bob (try 0.5 ... 2.5)
]]

local kIntroDuration = 1.1
local kOutroDuration = 0.9
local kFallbackClipLength = 6.0
local kBaseWaveDegrees = 4.0
local kBaseStagger = 0.05
local kBaseRise = 0.07
local kBaseBob = 0.01

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    -- Rotation → pure sway amplitude (read, then overwrite same field).
    local waveAmplitudeDegrees = kBaseWaveDegrees + ctx.global.rotation
    ctx.global.rotation = mt.wave(ctx.time, 0.22, 0.0) * waveAmplitudeDegrees

    -- Scale → pure travel coefficient: capture, neutralize size, hand off
    -- to OnLayout via inactive gradient.angle (gradient stays off).
    local scaleKnob = ctx.global.scale
    if scaleKnob < 0.05 then
        scaleKnob = 0.05
    end
    ctx.global.scale = 1.0
    ctx.global.gradient.color_space = "none"
    ctx.global.gradient.angle = scaleKnob
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)

    local staggerAmount = mt.clamp(kBaseStagger + ctx.global.tracking, 0.0, 0.6)
    -- Scale knob recovered from same-frame handoff (size already forced to 1).
    local scaleKnob = ctx.global.gradient.angle
    if scaleKnob < 0.05 then
        scaleKnob = 0.05
    end
    local lineSpacingKnob = ctx.global.line_spacing
    if lineSpacingKnob < 0.05 then
        lineSpacingKnob = 0.05
    end

    local riseAmount = kBaseRise * scaleKnob
    local bobAmount = kBaseBob * lineSpacingKnob

    for index, character, info in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local order = info.progress

        local introRaw = mt.stagger_progress(introAmount, order, staggerAmount)
        local outroRaw = mt.stagger_progress(outroAmount, order, staggerAmount)
        local introEased = mt.ease.out_back(introRaw)
        local outroEased = mt.ease.in_cubic(outroRaw)
        local steadyWeight = mt.saturate(introEased) * (1.0 - outroEased)

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 1. Intro: staggered pop from below (rise from Scale knob)
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local introOffsetY = (1.0 - mt.saturate(introEased)) * riseAmount
        local introScale = mt.lerp(0.72, 1.0, mt.saturate(introEased))

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 2. Steady: phase bob (Line spacing knob)
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local phase = order * math.pi * 2.0 + ctx.time * 1.7
        local bob = math.sin(phase) * bobAmount * steadyWeight
        local twist = math.sin(phase * 0.55) * 4.0 * steadyWeight

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 3. Outro: reverse cascade drop
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local outroOffsetY = -outroEased * riseAmount * 1.1

        character.offset_y = 0.5 + introOffsetY + bob + outroOffsetY
        character.offset_x = 0.5
        character.scale = introScale * (1.0 - outroEased * 0.15)
        character.rotation = twist
        character.opacity = mt.saturate(introRaw * 2.5) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_quad(outroRaw))
    end
end

name: 57_newtons_cradle.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @duration 6.0
-- @title Newtons Cradle
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 6
--[[ @description
Newton's cradle. The end characters swing along pendulum arcs and
collide like steel balls, passing displacement and a color shockwave
through the motionless characters between them.
]]

local kIntroDuration = 1.0
local kOutroDuration = 0.9
local kFallbackClipLength = 6.0

local kSwingPeriod = 0.35 -- seconds for one swing leg (crisp, snappy pendulum)
local kShockDelayPerChar = 0.012 -- seconds delay per char (12ms for ultra-fast, sharp shockwave)
local kMaxSwingAngle = 35.0 -- degrees of max pendulum swing angle
local kPendulumLength = 0.28 -- normalized arc radius for pendulum motion
local kImpactSquash = 0.25 -- horizontal squash factor upon collision
local kImpactDuration = 0.12 -- sharp recovery duration for impact pulse
local kShockPulseDistance = 0.016 -- horizontal shift for inner shockwave

-- Color palette settings for shockwave propagation
local kBaseHue = 0.58 -- cool cyan/blue resting state hue
local kBaseSat = 0.30
local kBaseVal = 0.88

local kShockHue = 0.08 -- warm orange/gold energy flash hue
local kShockSat = 0.90
local kShockVal = 1.0

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)
    local characterCount = math.max(ctx.char_count, 1)

    -- Calculate total shockwave travel time across the character line
    local shockTravelTime = math.max(0, characterCount - 1) * kShockDelayPerChar

    -- Complete cycle timeline:
    -- Leg 0: Right Out (duration kSwingPeriod)
    -- Leg 1: Right Return & Impact (duration kSwingPeriod)
    -- Leg 2: Shock R -> L Travel (duration shockTravelTime)
    -- Leg 3: Left Out (duration kSwingPeriod)
    -- Leg 4: Left Return & Impact (duration kSwingPeriod)
    -- Leg 5: Shock L -> R Travel (duration shockTravelTime)
    local cycleTime = 4.0 * kSwingPeriod + 2.0 * shockTravelTime
    local localTime = ctx.time % cycleTime

    -- Keyframe timestamps within full cycle
    local tRightOutStart = 0.0
    local tRightReturnStart = kSwingPeriod
    local tRightImpact = 2.0 * kSwingPeriod
    local tLeftOutStart = 2.0 * kSwingPeriod + shockTravelTime
    local tLeftReturnStart = 3.0 * kSwingPeriod + shockTravelTime
    local tLeftImpact = 4.0 * kSwingPeriod + shockTravelTime

    -- Timestamps for shockwave arrival at ends
    local timeSinceRightImpact = localTime - tRightImpact
    if timeSinceRightImpact < 0.0 then
        timeSinceRightImpact = timeSinceRightImpact + cycleTime
    end

    local timeSinceLeftImpact = localTime - tLeftImpact
    if timeSinceLeftImpact < 0.0 then
        timeSinceLeftImpact = timeSinceLeftImpact + cycleTime
    end

    -- Calculate pendulum angles for left and right ends
    local leftAngle = 0.0
    local rightAngle = 0.0

    if localTime >= tRightOutStart and localTime < tRightReturnStart then
        -- Right end swinging OUT (0 -> +kMaxSwingAngle)
        local progress = (localTime - tRightOutStart) / kSwingPeriod
        rightAngle = kMaxSwingAngle * math.sin(progress * (math.pi * 0.5))
    elseif localTime >= tRightReturnStart and localTime < tRightImpact then
        -- Right end swinging BACK (+kMaxSwingAngle -> 0) -> Strikes at tRightImpact!
        local progress = (localTime - tRightReturnStart) / kSwingPeriod
        rightAngle = kMaxSwingAngle * math.cos(progress * (math.pi * 0.5))
    elseif localTime >= tLeftOutStart and localTime < tLeftReturnStart then
        -- Left end swinging OUT (0 -> -kMaxSwingAngle) - starts PRECISELY when R->L shock arrives!
        local progress = (localTime - tLeftOutStart) / kSwingPeriod
        leftAngle = -kMaxSwingAngle * math.sin(progress * (math.pi * 0.5))
    elseif localTime >= tLeftReturnStart and localTime < tLeftImpact then
        -- Left end swinging BACK (-kMaxSwingAngle -> 0) -> Strikes at tLeftImpact!
        local progress = (localTime - tLeftReturnStart) / kSwingPeriod
        leftAngle = -kMaxSwingAngle * math.cos(progress * (math.pi * 0.5))
    end

    for index, character, info in mt.each_char(ctx) do

        local rotation = 0.0
        local offsetX = 0.5
        local offsetY = 0.5
        local stretchX = 1.0
        local stretchY = 1.0
        local shockIntensity = 0.0

        if characterCount == 1 then
            -- Single character simple back-and-forth pendulum
            local angleNormalized = math.sin(ctx.time * (math.pi / (2.0 * kSwingPeriod)))
            local angle = angleNormalized * kMaxSwingAngle
            local rad = math.rad(angle)
            rotation = angle
            offsetX = 0.5 + kPendulumLength * math.sin(rad)
            offsetY = 0.5 + kPendulumLength * (1.0 - math.cos(rad))
            shockIntensity = math.abs(angleNormalized) * 0.5
        else
            local isLeftEnd = (index == 1)
            local isRightEnd = (index == characterCount)
            local isMiddle = not (isLeftEnd or isRightEnd)

            if isLeftEnd then
                local rad = math.rad(leftAngle)
                rotation = leftAngle
                offsetX = 0.5 + kPendulumLength * math.sin(rad)
                offsetY = 0.5 + kPendulumLength * (1.0 - math.cos(rad))

                -- Impact squash when Left end strikes or is struck by arriving R->L shock
                local sinceHit = timeSinceLeftImpact
                if sinceHit >= 0.0 and sinceHit < kImpactDuration then
                    local progress = sinceHit / kImpactDuration
                    local squash = (1.0 - mt.ease.out_quad(progress)) * kImpactSquash
                    stretchX = 1.0 + squash
                    stretchY = 1.0 - squash * 0.4
                    shockIntensity = math.sin(progress * math.pi)
                else
                    shockIntensity = math.abs(leftAngle / kMaxSwingAngle) * 0.5
                end
            elseif isRightEnd then
                local rad = math.rad(rightAngle)
                rotation = rightAngle
                offsetX = 0.5 + kPendulumLength * math.sin(rad)
                offsetY = 0.5 + kPendulumLength * (1.0 - math.cos(rad))

                -- Impact squash when Right end strikes or is struck by arriving L->R shock
                local sinceHit = timeSinceRightImpact
                if sinceHit >= 0.0 and sinceHit < kImpactDuration then
                    local progress = sinceHit / kImpactDuration
                    local squash = (1.0 - mt.ease.out_quad(progress)) * kImpactSquash
                    stretchX = 1.0 + squash
                    stretchY = 1.0 - squash * 0.4
                    shockIntensity = math.sin(progress * math.pi)
                else
                    shockIntensity = math.abs(rightAngle / kMaxSwingAngle) * 0.5
                end
            elseif isMiddle then
                local distFromLeft = index - 1
                local distFromRight = characterCount - index

                -- Shockwave traveling Right -> Left (after Right Impact at tRightImpact)
                local shockRightTime = timeSinceRightImpact - distFromRight * kShockDelayPerChar
                if shockRightTime >= 0.0 and shockRightTime < kImpactDuration then
                    local progress = shockRightTime / kImpactDuration
                    local impulse = math.sin(progress * math.pi) * (1.0 - progress)
                    offsetX = 0.5 - kShockPulseDistance * impulse
                    stretchX = 1.0 + kImpactSquash * 0.35 * impulse
                    shockIntensity = math.max(shockIntensity, impulse)
                end

                -- Shockwave traveling Left -> Right (after Left Impact at tLeftImpact)
                local shockLeftTime = timeSinceLeftImpact - distFromLeft * kShockDelayPerChar
                if shockLeftTime >= 0.0 and shockLeftTime < kImpactDuration then
                    local progress = shockLeftTime / kImpactDuration
                    local impulse = math.sin(progress * math.pi) * (1.0 - progress)
                    offsetX = 0.5 + kShockPulseDistance * impulse
                    stretchX = 1.0 + kImpactSquash * 0.35 * impulse
                    shockIntensity = math.max(shockIntensity, impulse)
                end
            end
        end

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- Synchronized Color & Luminance Wave
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local baseColor = mt.color.from_hsv(kBaseHue, kBaseSat, kBaseVal, 1.0)
        local shockColor = mt.color.from_hsv(kShockHue, kShockSat, kShockVal, 1.0)

        character.fill.use = true
        character.fill.color = mt.color.lerp(baseColor, shockColor, mt.saturate(shockIntensity))

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- Intro / Outro Integration
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local order = info.progress

        local introRaw = mt.stagger_progress(introAmount, order, 0.25)
        local outroRaw = mt.stagger_progress(outroAmount, 1.0 - order, 0.25)

        local introEased = mt.ease.out_cubic(introRaw)
        local outroEased = mt.ease.in_cubic(outroRaw)

        local introDropY = (1.0 - introEased) * 0.2
        local outroFlyY = -outroEased * 0.2

        character.pivot_x = 0.5
        character.pivot_y = 0.5
        character.offset_x = offsetX
        character.offset_y = offsetY - introDropY + outroFlyY
        character.rotation = rotation * introEased
        character.stretch_x = stretchX
        character.stretch_y = stretchY
        character.opacity = mt.saturate(introRaw * 3.0) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_quad(outroRaw))
    end
end
description:
Newton's cradle. The end characters swing along pendulum arcs and
collide like steel balls, passing displacement and a color shockwave
through the motionless characters between them.
title: Newtons Cradle
author: Mug

name: 58_manual_timing_table.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @duration 4.5
-- @title Manual Timing Table
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 6
--[[ @description
Karaoke / lyric-video timing table. Each character reads its own cue
time out of kRevealSeconds -- a hand-written cue sheet in real clip
seconds -- and animates independently, so cues can repeat, skip
characters or land out of reading order.
]]

-- Lyric line: "Hey there, hold on"
--             123456789...
local kRevealSeconds = {
    [1] = 0.0, -- "H"ey -- line starts on the beat
    [4] = 0.9, -- t"h"ere -- next word lands on beat 2
    [11] = 2.0, -- "h"old -- held back for a pause after the comma
    [16] = 2.9, -- "o"n -- closing word, quick landing
}
local kDefaultStep = 0.09 -- fallback per-character pace between explicit cues
local kPopDuration = 0.22 -- seconds each character takes to settle in
local kPopScale = 0.4 -- overshoot amount at the moment a character lands

-- Time character `index` appears: explicit cues from kRevealSeconds, with
-- kDefaultStep filling every gap (before the first cue, between cues, and
-- past the last cue).
local function revealTimeFor(index)
    local precedingIndex = 0
    local precedingTime = 0.0
    for cueIndex, cueTime in pairs(kRevealSeconds) do
        if cueIndex <= index and cueIndex > precedingIndex then
            precedingIndex = cueIndex
            precedingTime = cueTime
        end
    end
    return precedingTime + (index - precedingIndex) * kDefaultStep
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    -- Each character is driven purely by its own cue time from the table
    -- above: no write_on reveal fraction, no shared forward-only cursor.
    -- A character with an earlier cue than its neighbor can pop in after
    -- it, or two characters can share the same cue and land together.
    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local secondsSinceReveal = ctx.time - revealTimeFor(index)

        -- Hidden entirely until its own cue time arrives.
        local isRevealed = secondsSinceReveal >= 0.0
        local settle = mt.ease.out_back(mt.saturate(secondsSinceReveal / kPopDuration))

        character.opacity = isRevealed and 1.0 or 0.0
        character.scale = 1.0 + (1.0 - settle) * kPopScale
    end
end
description:
Karaoke / lyric-video timing table. Each character reads its own cue
time out of kRevealSeconds -- a hand-written cue sheet in real clip
seconds -- and animates independently, so cues can repeat, skip
characters or land out of reading order.
title: Manual Timing Table

source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @duration 5.0
-- @recommend lang ja pos 0.5 0.18 bg checkerboard #55616d
-- @title Dialogue Cue
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 6
--[[ @description
Dialogue cue. A restrained subtitle treatment: a translucent caption
card grows from the bottom edge, the line resolves quickly and then
holds perfectly still for comfortable reading, and at the end the
sentence gathers toward its final punctuation before the card closes.
]]

local kIntroDuration = 0.48
local kOutroDuration = 0.58
local kFallbackClipLength = 5.0
local kLineRevealDelay = 0.1
local kReadingDirectionDelay = 0.1
local kTextRiseDistance = 0.018
local kIntroStretchY = 0.82

local kCardMarginX = 24.0
local kCardMarginY = 16.0
local kCardOpacity = 0.72
local kCardColor = { r = 0.025, g = 0.035, b = 0.065, a = 1.0 }
local kCueColor = { r = 0.38, g = 0.82, b = 1.0, a = 0.95 }
local kCueWidth = 5.0

local kTextColor = { r = 0.96, g = 0.97, b = 1.0, a = 1.0 }
local kOutlineColor = { r = 0.015, g = 0.02, b = 0.04, a = 0.92 }
local kOutlineWidth = 0.012
local kShadowColor = { r = 0.0, g = 0.0, b = 0.0, a = 0.72 }
local kShadowDistance = 0.75
local kShadowAngle = 90.0

local kOutroCharacterStagger = 0.2
local kSentenceGather = 0.055
local kPunctuationHoldDelay = 0.48
local kPunctuationPulse = 0.1

-- mt.text.classify also recognises the ideographic space, which a plain
-- "%s" pattern would miss in Japanese subtitles.
local function isWhitespace(text)
    return mt.text.classify(text) == "space"
end

local function getFinalVisibleCharacterIndex(ctx)
    local finalVisibleCharacterIndex = 0
    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        if not isWhitespace(character.text) then
            finalVisibleCharacterIndex = index
        end
    end
    return finalVisibleCharacterIndex
end

local function measureSubtitleBlock(ctx)
    local minimumEdgeX = 0.5
    local maximumEdgeX = 0.5
    local minimumEdgeY = 0.5
    local maximumEdgeY = 0.5
    local hasVisibleCharacter = false
    local maximumLineIndex = 1

    for _, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        maximumLineIndex = math.max(maximumLineIndex, character.line_index)
        if not isWhitespace(character.text) then
            local geometry = character.geometry
            local leftEdge = geometry.bounds_center_x - geometry.bounds_width * 0.5
            local rightEdge = geometry.bounds_center_x + geometry.bounds_width * 0.5
            local bottomEdge = geometry.bounds_center_y - geometry.bounds_height * 0.5
            local topEdge = geometry.bounds_center_y + geometry.bounds_height * 0.5

            if hasVisibleCharacter then
                minimumEdgeX = math.min(minimumEdgeX, leftEdge)
                maximumEdgeX = math.max(maximumEdgeX, rightEdge)
                minimumEdgeY = math.min(minimumEdgeY, bottomEdge)
                maximumEdgeY = math.max(maximumEdgeY, topEdge)
            else
                minimumEdgeX = leftEdge
                maximumEdgeX = rightEdge
                minimumEdgeY = bottomEdge
                maximumEdgeY = topEdge
                hasVisibleCharacter = true
            end
        end
    end

    return {
        minimumEdgeX = minimumEdgeX,
        maximumEdgeX = maximumEdgeX,
        minimumEdgeY = minimumEdgeY,
        maximumEdgeY = maximumEdgeY,
        maximumLineIndex = maximumLineIndex,
        hasVisibleCharacter = hasVisibleCharacter,
    }
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    ctx.global.fill.color = kTextColor
    ctx.global.stroke.width = kOutlineWidth
    ctx.global.stroke.gap = 0.0
    ctx.global.stroke.color = kOutlineColor
    ctx.global.stroke.order = "fill_over_stroke"
    ctx.global.stroke.join = "round"

    ctx.global.shadow.enabled = true
    ctx.global.shadow.distance = kShadowDistance
    ctx.global.shadow.angle = kShadowAngle
    ctx.global.shadow.color = kShadowColor
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)
    local subtitleBlock = measureSubtitleBlock(ctx)
    local finalVisibleCharacterIndex = getFinalVisibleCharacterIndex(ctx)
    local safeCharacterCount = math.max(ctx.char_count, 1)

    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Caption card: bottom-anchored vertical opening and closing
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    local fontSizePixels = (ctx.font.ascent + ctx.font.descent) * ctx.canvas.height
    local textHeightPixels =
        (subtitleBlock.maximumEdgeY - subtitleBlock.minimumEdgeY) * ctx.canvas.height
    local zeroHeightMargin =
        -textHeightPixels / math.max(fontSizePixels, 1.0) * 100.0 * 0.5
    local cardIntro = mt.ease.out_cubic(introAmount)
    local cardOutro = mt.ease.in_cubic(outroAmount)
    local cardOpenAmount = cardIntro * (1.0 - cardOutro)
    local animatedMarginY = mt.lerp(zeroHeightMargin, kCardMarginY, cardOpenAmount)
    local bottomAnchorOffsetY = kCardMarginY - animatedMarginY

    ctx.bounding_box.enabled = subtitleBlock.hasVisibleCharacter
    ctx.bounding_box.draw_top = false
    ctx.bounding_box.draw_bottom = false
    ctx.bounding_box.draw_right = false
    ctx.bounding_box.draw_left = true
    ctx.bounding_box.color = kCueColor
    ctx.bounding_box.width = kCueWidth
    ctx.bounding_box.start_cap = "round"
    ctx.bounding_box.end_cap = "round"
    ctx.bounding_box.margin_x = kCardMarginX
    ctx.bounding_box.margin_y = animatedMarginY
    ctx.bounding_box.stroke_offset_y = bottomAnchorOffsetY
    ctx.bounding_box.fill_enabled = true
    ctx.bounding_box.fill_color = kCardColor
    ctx.bounding_box.fill_opacity = kCardOpacity * cardOpenAmount
    ctx.bounding_box.fill_offset_y = bottomAnchorOffsetY

    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Subtitle text: fast line resolve, stable hold, punctuation beat
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    local finalCharacterPositionX = 0.5
    local finalCharacterPositionY = 0.5
    if finalVisibleCharacterIndex > 0 then
        local finalGeometry = ctx.chars[finalVisibleCharacterIndex].geometry
        finalCharacterPositionX = finalGeometry.bounds_center_x
        finalCharacterPositionY = finalGeometry.bounds_center_y
    end

    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local geometry = character.geometry
        local characterOrder = mt.distribute(index, safeCharacterCount)
        local lineOrder =
            mt.distribute(character.line_index, subtitleBlock.maximumLineIndex)
        local revealDelay =
            lineOrder * kLineRevealDelay + characterOrder * kReadingDirectionDelay
        local characterIntro = mt.ease.out_cubic(
            mt.saturate(introAmount * (1.0 + revealDelay) - revealDelay)
        )

        local reverseOrder = 1.0 - characterOrder
        local outroDelay = reverseOrder * kOutroCharacterStagger
        local characterOutro = mt.ease.in_quad(
            mt.saturate(outroAmount * (1.0 + outroDelay) - outroDelay)
        )

        local punctuationPulse = 0.0
        if index == finalVisibleCharacterIndex then
            characterOutro = mt.ease.in_quad(
                mt.saturate(
                    (outroAmount - kPunctuationHoldDelay)
                        / (1.0 - kPunctuationHoldDelay)
                )
            )
            punctuationPulse =
                math.sin(mt.saturate(outroAmount / kPunctuationHoldDelay) * math.pi)
                    * kPunctuationPulse
        end

        local gatherOffsetX =
            (finalCharacterPositionX - geometry.bounds_center_x)
                * kSentenceGather
                * characterOutro
        local gatherOffsetY =
            (finalCharacterPositionY - geometry.bounds_center_y)
                * kSentenceGather
                * characterOutro

        character.offset_x = 0.5 + gatherOffsetX
        character.offset_y = 0.5
            - (1.0 - characterIntro) * kTextRiseDistance
            + gatherOffsetY
        character.stretch_y = mt.lerp(kIntroStretchY, 1.0, characterIntro)
        character.scale = 1.0 + punctuationPulse
        character.opacity = characterIntro * (1.0 - characterOutro)
    end
end

-- @MugTypography
-- @duration 6.0
-- @required 3d
-- @title Opal Loom
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 6
--[[ @description
Opal loom. Every glyph part is a shard of polarized opal: the shards
open radially like a rose window, shimmer with iridescent interference
under a quiet camera orbit, then are woven into a two-strand aurora
ribbon and disappear down the finished thread.
]]

local kIntroDuration = 1.45
local kOutroDuration = 1.2
local kFallbackClipLength = 6.0
local kIntroStaggerAmount = 0.42
local kOutroStaggerAmount = 0.32

local kFoldScale = 0.12
local kFoldRotationTurns = 0.42
local kFoldDepth = 0.42
local kFoldSideDrift = 0.025
local kEdgeOnMinimum = 72.0
local kEdgeOnMaximum = 104.0

local kCameraYawAmplitude = 5.0
local kCameraPitchAmplitude = 2.4
local kCameraYawFrequency = 0.09
local kCameraPitchFrequency = 0.13
local kCameraPerspective = 0.24
local kCameraZoom = 1.03

local kInterferenceScalePrimary = 13.0
local kInterferenceScaleSecondary = 17.0
local kInterferenceSpeedPrimary = 1.35
local kInterferenceSpeedSecondary = 0.92
local kHueBase = 0.57
local kHueSpatialRange = 0.19
local kHueDriftSpeed = 0.025
local kCausticSharpness = 5.0
local kFacetDepth = 0.028
local kFacetTilt = 5.5

local kStrokeWidth = 0.006
local kStrokeGap = 0.001
local kStrokeDark = { r = 0.045, g = 0.055, b = 0.09, a = 0.92 }
local kStrokeGlint = { r = 1.0, g = 0.86, b = 0.55, a = 0.98 }

local kRibbonLeft = 0.12
local kRibbonRight = 0.88
local kRibbonAmplitude = 0.052
local kRibbonTurns = 1.35
local kRibbonPhaseSpeed = 0.55
local kRibbonStretchX = 0.24
local kRibbonStretchY = 0.055
local kRibbonDepth = -0.18
local kRibbonEdgeOn = 82.0
local kRibbonFadeStart = 0.68

local kTwoPi = math.pi * 2.0
local kCenterEpsilon = 1e-5

local function rotateAspectCorrected(positionX, positionY, angle, aspectRatio)
    local worldPositionX = positionX * aspectRatio
    local cosine = math.cos(angle)
    local sine = math.sin(angle)
    local rotatedWorldX = worldPositionX * cosine - positionY * sine
    local rotatedPositionY = worldPositionX * sine + positionY * cosine
    return rotatedWorldX / aspectRatio, rotatedPositionY
end

local function sharpenPositiveWave(value)
    return math.max(value, 0.0) ^ kCausticSharpness
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)
    local settledAmount = mt.ease.out_cubic(introAmount) * (1.0 - mt.ease.in_cubic(outroAmount))

    ctx.camera.yaw = mt.wave(ctx.time, kCameraYawFrequency, 0.0)
        * kCameraYawAmplitude
        * settledAmount
    ctx.camera.pitch = mt.wave(ctx.time, kCameraPitchFrequency, 0.25)
        * kCameraPitchAmplitude
        * settledAmount
    ctx.camera.perspective = kCameraPerspective
    ctx.camera.zoom = kCameraZoom

    ctx.global.shadow.enabled = true
    ctx.global.shadow.distance = 0.7
    ctx.global.shadow.angle = 118.0 + mt.wave(ctx.time, 0.08, 0.0) * 18.0
    ctx.global.shadow.color = { r = 0.05, g = 0.16, b = 0.32, a = 0.5 }
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)
    local partCount = math.max(ctx.part_count, 1)
    local aspectRatio = ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio
    local instanceSeed = ctx.meta.instance_seed
    local ribbonPhase = ctx.time * kRibbonPhaseSpeed

    for index, part in mt.each_part(ctx) do
        local geometry = part.geometry
        local partOrder = mt.distribute(index, partCount)

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 1. Bloom: unfold a character-local opal rose window
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local introStagger =
            mt.random_range(instanceSeed, index, 0.0, kIntroStaggerAmount)
        local introProgress = mt.saturate(introAmount * (1.0 + introStagger) - introStagger)
        local bloomAmount = mt.ease.out_back(introProgress)

        local localPositionX = geometry.local_center_x
        local localPositionY = geometry.local_center_y
        local localDistance =
            math.sqrt(localPositionX * localPositionX + localPositionY * localPositionY)
        local fallbackAngle =
            mt.random_range(instanceSeed, index + partCount, 0.0, kTwoPi)
        local radialAngle = fallbackAngle
        if localDistance > kCenterEpsilon then
            radialAngle = math.atan(localPositionY, localPositionX * aspectRatio)
        end

        local foldDirection =
            mt.random_range(instanceSeed, index + partCount * 2, 0.0, 1.0) < 0.5 and -1.0 or 1.0
        local foldAngle = foldDirection * kFoldRotationTurns * kTwoPi
        local foldedPositionX, foldedPositionY = rotateAspectCorrected(
            localPositionX * kFoldScale,
            localPositionY * kFoldScale,
            foldAngle,
            aspectRatio
        )
        foldedPositionX = foldedPositionX + math.cos(radialAngle) * kFoldSideDrift
        foldedPositionY = foldedPositionY + math.sin(radialAngle) * kFoldSideDrift

        local bloomPositionX = mt.lerp(foldedPositionX, localPositionX, bloomAmount)
        local bloomPositionY = mt.lerp(foldedPositionY, localPositionY, bloomAmount)
        local bloomOffsetX = bloomPositionX - localPositionX
        local bloomOffsetY = bloomPositionY - localPositionY

        local edgeOnAngle = mt.random_range(
            instanceSeed,
            index + partCount * 3,
            kEdgeOnMinimum,
            kEdgeOnMaximum
        )
        local introYaw = foldDirection * edgeOnAngle * (1.0 - bloomAmount)
        local introPitch = -foldDirection * edgeOnAngle * 0.55 * (1.0 - bloomAmount)
        local introRotation = math.deg(foldAngle) * (1.0 - bloomAmount)

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 2. Living glass: moving polarized interference and caustics
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local worldPositionX = (geometry.canvas_center_x - 0.5) * aspectRatio
        local worldPositionY = geometry.canvas_center_y - 0.5
        local interferencePrimary = math.sin(
            worldPositionX * kInterferenceScalePrimary
                + worldPositionY * kInterferenceScalePrimary * 0.62
                - ctx.time * kInterferenceSpeedPrimary
                + fallbackAngle
        )
        local interferenceSecondary = math.sin(
            -worldPositionX * kInterferenceScaleSecondary * 0.48
                + worldPositionY * kInterferenceScaleSecondary
                + ctx.time * kInterferenceSpeedSecondary
        )
        local interference = (interferencePrimary + interferenceSecondary) * 0.25 + 0.5
        local caustic = sharpenPositiveWave(interferencePrimary * interferenceSecondary)
        local hue = mt.wrap(
            kHueBase
                + (interference - 0.5) * kHueSpatialRange
                + partOrder * 0.08
                + ctx.time * kHueDriftSpeed,
            0.0,
            1.0
        )

        local deepOpal = mt.color.from_oklch(0.5, 0.15, hue, 1.0)
        local livingOpal = mt.color.from_oklch(0.78 + interference * 0.1, 0.18, hue, 1.0)
        local pearlGlint = mt.color.from_oklch(0.985, 0.025, hue, 1.0)
        local settledColor = mt.color.lerp(deepOpal, livingOpal, bloomAmount)
        local opalColor = mt.color.lerp(settledColor, pearlGlint, caustic)

        local idleYaw = interferencePrimary * kFacetTilt * bloomAmount
        local idlePitch = interferenceSecondary * kFacetTilt * bloomAmount
        local idleDepth = -caustic * kFacetDepth * bloomAmount

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 3. Loom: weave every facet into a two-strand aurora ribbon
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local outroStagger = (1.0 - partOrder) * kOutroStaggerAmount
        local outroProgress = mt.saturate(outroAmount * (1.0 + outroStagger) - outroStagger)
        local weaveAmount = mt.ease.in_out_cubic(outroProgress)
        local strandDirection = (index % 2 == 0) and 1.0 or -1.0
        local strandAngle = (partOrder * kRibbonTurns + ribbonPhase) * kTwoPi
        local ribbonPositionX = mt.lerp(kRibbonLeft, kRibbonRight, partOrder)
        local ribbonPositionY =
            0.5 + math.sin(strandAngle) * kRibbonAmplitude * strandDirection
        local ribbonOffsetX = ribbonPositionX - geometry.canvas_center_x
        local ribbonOffsetY = ribbonPositionY - geometry.canvas_center_y
        local ribbonSlope = math.cos(strandAngle)
            * kRibbonAmplitude
            * strandDirection
            * kRibbonTurns
            * kTwoPi
            / ((kRibbonRight - kRibbonLeft) * aspectRatio)
        local ribbonRotation = -math.deg(math.atan(ribbonSlope))
        local ribbonFlare = mt.smoothstep(0.18, 0.62, weaveAmount)
            * (1.0 - mt.smoothstep(0.62, 1.0, weaveAmount))

        part.offset_x = 0.5 + mt.lerp(bloomOffsetX, ribbonOffsetX, weaveAmount)
        part.offset_y = 0.5 + mt.lerp(bloomOffsetY, ribbonOffsetY, weaveAmount)
        part.rotation = mt.lerp(introRotation, ribbonRotation, weaveAmount)
        part.yaw = mt.lerp(introYaw + idleYaw, strandDirection * kRibbonEdgeOn, weaveAmount)
        part.pitch = mt.lerp(introPitch + idlePitch, 0.0, weaveAmount)
        part.z = mt.lerp((1.0 - bloomAmount) * kFoldDepth + idleDepth, kRibbonDepth, weaveAmount)
        part.scale = mt.lerp(kFoldScale + (1.0 - kFoldScale) * bloomAmount, 1.0, weaveAmount)
        part.stretch_x = mt.lerp(1.0, kRibbonStretchX, weaveAmount)
        part.stretch_y = mt.lerp(1.0, kRibbonStretchY, weaveAmount)

        local introOpacity = mt.saturate(introProgress * 4.0)
        local outroOpacity = 1.0
            - mt.smoothstep(kRibbonFadeStart, 1.0, outroProgress)
        part.opacity = introOpacity * outroOpacity

        part.fill.use = true
        part.fill.color = mt.color.lerp(opalColor, pearlGlint, ribbonFlare)
        part.stroke.use = true
        part.stroke.width = kStrokeWidth
        part.stroke.gap = kStrokeGap
        part.stroke.color = mt.color.lerp(kStrokeDark, kStrokeGlint, caustic + ribbonFlare)
        part.shadow.use = true
        part.shadow.color = mt.color.with_alpha(opalColor, 0.28 + caustic * 0.32)
    end
end
