-- @MugTypography
-- @duration 7.0
-- @title Ghost Ink Lyrics
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 6
--[[ @description
Ghost ink lyrics. The whole line arrives as faint ghost ink so the
phrase can be anticipated, each word then blooms in sequence with a
traveling color flare and settles into calm pearl lettering, and the
finished phrase exhales upward in word order at the end of the clip.
]]

local kIntroDuration = 0.85
local kOutroDuration = 0.9
local kFallbackClipLength = 7.0
local kIntroCenterStagger = 0.38
local kOutroWordStagger = 0.42

local kGhostOpacity = 0.2
local kSungOpacity = 0.78
local kActiveOpacityBoost = 0.22
local kIntroRiseDistance = 0.035
local kActiveLift = 0.018
local kOutroLift = 0.09
local kOutroSpread = 0.035
local kActiveScale = 0.12
local kActiveTracking = 0.008
local kIntroTracking = 0.04
local kOutroTracking = 0.055
local kIntroStretchY = 0.12
local kOutroRotation = 5.0

local kLetterSweepSpan = 0.58
local kLetterSweepOffset = 0.2
local kFlareWidth = 0.2
local kFlareSharpness = 2.0

local kGhostColor = { r = 0.24, g = 0.23, b = 0.36, a = 1.0 }
local kSungColor = { r = 0.9, g = 0.89, b = 0.95, a = 1.0 }
local kShadowAlpha = 0.5
local kStrokeWidth = 0.004
local kStrokeGap = 0.0

-- mt.text.classify also recognises the ideographic space, which a plain
-- "%s" pattern would miss in Japanese lyrics.
local function isWhitespace(text)
    return mt.text.classify(text) == "space"
end

local function buildLyricTokens(ctx)
    local containsWhitespace = false
    for _, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        if isWhitespace(character.text) then
            containsWhitespace = true
        end
    end

    local tokenByCharacter = {}
    local tokenStartByCharacter = {}
    local tokenEndByCharacter = {}
    local tokenCount = 0

    if containsWhitespace then
        local currentTokenStart = 0
        for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
            if isWhitespace(character.text) then
                if currentTokenStart > 0 then
                    for tokenCharacterIndex = currentTokenStart, index - 1 do
                        tokenStartByCharacter[tokenCharacterIndex] = currentTokenStart
                        tokenEndByCharacter[tokenCharacterIndex] = index - 1
                    end
                end
                tokenByCharacter[index] = 0
                currentTokenStart = 0
            else
                if currentTokenStart == 0 then
                    tokenCount = tokenCount + 1
                    currentTokenStart = index
                end
                tokenByCharacter[index] = tokenCount
            end
        end

        if currentTokenStart > 0 then
            for tokenCharacterIndex = currentTokenStart, ctx.char_count do
                tokenStartByCharacter[tokenCharacterIndex] = currentTokenStart
                tokenEndByCharacter[tokenCharacterIndex] = ctx.char_count
            end
        end
    else
        for index = 1, ctx.char_count do
            tokenCount = tokenCount + 1
            tokenByCharacter[index] = tokenCount
            tokenStartByCharacter[index] = index
            tokenEndByCharacter[index] = index
        end
    end

    return tokenByCharacter, tokenStartByCharacter, tokenEndByCharacter, tokenCount
end

local function getCharacterOrderInToken(index, tokenStartIndex, tokenEndIndex)
    local characterOrder = 0.5
    if tokenEndIndex > tokenStartIndex then
        characterOrder = (index - tokenStartIndex) / (tokenEndIndex - tokenStartIndex)
    end
    return characterOrder
end

local function getFlareAmount(tokenProgress, characterOrder)
    local flarePosition =
        kLetterSweepOffset + characterOrder * kLetterSweepSpan
    local flareDistance = (tokenProgress - flarePosition) / kFlareWidth
    return math.exp(-(flareDistance * flareDistance)) ^ kFlareSharpness
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)

    ctx.global.tracking = mt.lerp(kIntroTracking, kActiveTracking, mt.ease.out_cubic(introAmount))
        + mt.ease.in_cubic(outroAmount) * (kOutroTracking - kActiveTracking)

    ctx.global.shadow.enabled = true
    ctx.global.shadow.distance = 0.85
    ctx.global.shadow.angle = 112.0
    ctx.global.shadow.color = { r = 0.3, g = 0.08, b = 0.42, a = kShadowAlpha }
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)
    local tokenByCharacter, tokenStartByCharacter, tokenEndByCharacter, tokenCount =
        buildLyricTokens(ctx)
    local safeTokenCount = math.max(tokenCount, 1)
    local safeCharacterCount = math.max(ctx.char_count, 1)
    local clipDuration = mt.timeline.duration(ctx, kFallbackClipLength)
    local singingDuration = math.max(clipDuration - kIntroDuration - kOutroDuration, 0.001)
    local singingProgress = mt.saturate((ctx.time - kIntroDuration) / singingDuration)

    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local tokenIndex = tokenByCharacter[index] or 0
        local characterOrder = mt.distribute(index, safeCharacterCount)
        local centerDistance = characterOrder * 2.0 - 1.0

        if tokenIndex == 0 then
            character.opacity = 0.0
        else
            local tokenOrder = mt.distribute(tokenIndex, safeTokenCount)
            local tokenStartProgress = (tokenIndex - 1) / safeTokenCount
            local tokenEndProgress = tokenIndex / safeTokenCount
            local tokenProgress = mt.saturate(
                (singingProgress - tokenStartProgress)
                    / math.max(tokenEndProgress - tokenStartProgress, 0.001)
            )

            local tokenStartIndex = tokenStartByCharacter[index]
            local tokenEndIndex = tokenEndByCharacter[index]
            local characterOrderInToken =
                getCharacterOrderInToken(index, tokenStartIndex, tokenEndIndex)
            local flareAmount = getFlareAmount(tokenProgress, characterOrderInToken)
            local activeAmount = math.sin(tokenProgress * math.pi)
            activeAmount = math.max(activeAmount, 0.0) ^ 0.7
            local sungAmount = mt.smoothstep(0.08, 0.82, tokenProgress)

            --------------------------------------------------------
            -- Ghost ink arrival: center characters arrive first
            --------------------------------------------------------
            local introDelay = math.abs(centerDistance) * kIntroCenterStagger
            local characterIntro = mt.ease.out_cubic(
                mt.saturate(introAmount * (1.0 + introDelay) - introDelay)
            )

            --------------------------------------------------------
            -- Active lyric: word bloom plus a character-level flare
            --------------------------------------------------------
            local liveHue = mt.wrap(
                0.94 + tokenOrder * 0.17 + ctx.time * 0.012,
                0.0,
                1.0
            )
            local activeColor = mt.color.from_oklch(0.78, 0.2, liveHue, 1.0)
            local flareColor = mt.color.from_oklch(0.97, 0.055, liveHue, 1.0)
            local restingColor = mt.color.lerp(kGhostColor, kSungColor, sungAmount)
            local lyricColor = mt.color.lerp(restingColor, activeColor, activeAmount)
            lyricColor = mt.color.lerp(lyricColor, flareColor, flareAmount)

            --------------------------------------------------------
            -- Final exhale: words leave in reading order
            --------------------------------------------------------
            local outroDelay = tokenOrder * kOutroWordStagger
            local characterOutro = mt.ease.in_cubic(
                mt.saturate(outroAmount * (1.0 + outroDelay) - outroDelay)
            )
            local exitDirection = (tokenIndex % 2 == 0) and 1.0 or -1.0

            local lyricOpacity = mt.lerp(kGhostOpacity, kSungOpacity, sungAmount)
                + activeAmount * kActiveOpacityBoost
            character.opacity = characterIntro
                * lyricOpacity
                * (1.0 - characterOutro)
            character.offset_x = 0.5 + centerDistance * kOutroSpread * characterOutro
            character.offset_y = 0.5
                - (1.0 - characterIntro) * kIntroRiseDistance
                + activeAmount * kActiveLift
                + characterOutro * kOutroLift
            character.scale = 1.0 + activeAmount * kActiveScale
            character.stretch_y = mt.lerp(kIntroStretchY, 1.0, characterIntro)
            character.rotation = exitDirection * kOutroRotation * characterOutro

            character.fill.use = true
            character.fill.color = lyricColor
            character.stroke.use = true
            character.stroke.width = kStrokeWidth
            character.stroke.gap = kStrokeGap
            character.stroke.color = mt.color.with_alpha(flareColor, 0.12 + flareAmount * 0.48)
            character.shadow.use = true
            character.shadow.color =
                mt.color.with_alpha(activeColor, 0.12 + activeAmount * 0.42)
        end
    end
end
description:
Ghost ink lyrics. The whole line arrives as faint ghost ink so the
phrase can be anticipated, each word then blooms in sequence with a
traveling color flare and settles into calm pearl lettering, and the
finished phrase exhales upward in word order at the end of the clip.
title: Ghost Ink Lyrics
author: Mug

name: 62_path_parade.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @duration 8.0
-- @title Path Parade
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 6
--[[ @description
Path parade. Characters queue as readable text along the bottom edge,
then depart clockwise one at a time around a closed path -- braking,
turning and squashing through each corner -- and rebuild the line when
they complete the circuit.
]]

local kPathPoints = {
    { x = 0.22, y = 0.82 },
    { x = 0.78, y = 0.82 },
    { x = 0.78, y = 0.18 },
    { x = 0.22, y = 0.18 },
}

local kIntroDuration = 0.65
local kOutroDuration = 0.7
local kFallbackClipLength = 8.0
local kIntroScale = 0.24
local kReadingSegmentIndex = 3
local kReadingEdgePadding = 0.1
local kBottomHoldDuration = 1.15
local kDepartureStaggerSeconds = 0.16
local kMaximumDepartureWaveDuration = 1.6
local kCircuitDuration = 4.4
local kCollectedHoldDuration = 0.9
local kCornerWindow = 0.2
local kCornerBrakeStrength = 0.42
local kCornerCutDistance = 0.022
local kCornerReleaseHop = 0.012
local kCornerCompression = 0.16
local kCornerReleaseScale = 0.09
local kCornerBankDegrees = 9.0
local kBottomEdgeReadingRotation = 180.0
local kTurnEpsilon = 1e-5

local kRestColor = { r = 0.72, g = 0.84, b = 1.0, a = 1.0 }
local kTurnColor = { r = 1.0, g = 0.48, b = 0.2, a = 1.0 }
local kReleaseColor = { r = 1.0, g = 0.94, b = 0.72, a = 1.0 }
local kStrokeColor = { r = 0.025, g = 0.05, b = 0.1, a = 0.94 }
local kStrokeWidth = 0.008
local kShadowColor = { r = 0.08, g = 0.34, b = 0.7, a = 0.48 }
local kShadowDistance = 0.8
local kShadowAngle = 110.0

local kTwoPi = math.pi * 2.0

local function getShortestAngleDifference(startAngle, endAngle)
    return (endAngle - startAngle + math.pi) % kTwoPi - math.pi
end

local function interpolateAngle(startAngle, endAngle, amount)
    return startAngle + getShortestAngleDifference(startAngle, endAngle) * amount
end

local function getTurnDirection(startAngle, endAngle)
    local angleDifference = getShortestAngleDifference(startAngle, endAngle)
    local turnDirection = 0.0
    if angleDifference > kTurnEpsilon then
        turnDirection = 1.0
    elseif angleDifference < -kTurnEpsilon then
        turnDirection = -1.0
    end
    return turnDirection
end

local function buildPathSegments(pathPoints, aspectRatio)
    local segments = {}
    local totalLength = 0.0

    for index = 1, #pathPoints do
        local startPoint = pathPoints[index]
        local endPoint = pathPoints[index % #pathPoints + 1]
        local distanceX = (endPoint.x - startPoint.x) * aspectRatio
        local distanceY = endPoint.y - startPoint.y
        local segmentLength = math.sqrt(distanceX * distanceX + distanceY * distanceY)
        local segmentAngle = math.atan(distanceY, distanceX)

        segments[index] = {
            startPoint = startPoint,
            endPoint = endPoint,
            length = segmentLength,
            angle = segmentAngle,
            cumulativeStart = totalLength,
        }
        totalLength = totalLength + segmentLength
    end

    return segments, totalLength
end

local function applyCornerBrake(segmentProgress)
    return mt.lerp(
        segmentProgress,
        mt.smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, segmentProgress),
        kCornerBrakeStrength
    )
end

local function invertCornerBrake(targetProgress)
    local lowerBound = 0.0
    local upperBound = 1.0
    local kSearchIterations = 14

    for _ = 1, kSearchIterations do
        local midpoint = (lowerBound + upperBound) * 0.5
        if applyCornerBrake(midpoint) < targetProgress then
            lowerBound = midpoint
        else
            upperBound = midpoint
        end
    end

    return (lowerBound + upperBound) * 0.5
end

local function measureNaturalText(ctx)
    local minimumX = 0.5
    local maximumX = 0.5
    local minimumY = 0.5
    local maximumY = 0.5
    local hasCharacter = false

    for _, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local geometry = character.geometry
        local leftEdge = geometry.bounds_center_x - geometry.bounds_width * 0.5
        local rightEdge = geometry.bounds_center_x + geometry.bounds_width * 0.5
        local bottomEdge = geometry.bounds_center_y - geometry.bounds_height * 0.5
        local topEdge = geometry.bounds_center_y + geometry.bounds_height * 0.5

        if hasCharacter then
            minimumX = math.min(minimumX, leftEdge)
            maximumX = math.max(maximumX, rightEdge)
            minimumY = math.min(minimumY, bottomEdge)
            maximumY = math.max(maximumY, topEdge)
        else
            minimumX = leftEdge
            maximumX = rightEdge
            minimumY = bottomEdge
            maximumY = topEdge
            hasCharacter = true
        end
    end

    return {
        centerX = (minimumX + maximumX) * 0.5,
        centerY = (minimumY + maximumY) * 0.5,
        width = maximumX - minimumX,
    }
end

local function sampleClosedPath(segments, totalLength, progress)
    local wrappedDistance = mt.wrap(progress, 0.0, 1.0) * totalLength
    local selectedSegmentIndex = 1
    local selectedSegmentProgress = 0.0
    local segmentFound = false

    for index = 1, #segments do
        local segment = segments[index]
        local cumulativeEnd = segment.cumulativeStart + segment.length
        if not segmentFound and wrappedDistance <= cumulativeEnd then
            selectedSegmentIndex = index
            selectedSegmentProgress =
                (wrappedDistance - segment.cumulativeStart) / math.max(segment.length, kTurnEpsilon)
            segmentFound = true
        end
    end

    selectedSegmentProgress = mt.saturate(selectedSegmentProgress)
    local selectedSegment = segments[selectedSegmentIndex]
    local previousSegment = segments[(selectedSegmentIndex - 2) % #segments + 1]
    local nextSegment = segments[selectedSegmentIndex % #segments + 1]

    -- A partial smoothstep keeps most of each edge moving steadily while
    -- still bringing velocity down as the character reaches a corner.
    local brakedProgress = applyCornerBrake(selectedSegmentProgress)
    local positionX =
        mt.lerp(selectedSegment.startPoint.x, selectedSegment.endPoint.x, brakedProgress)
    local positionY =
        mt.lerp(selectedSegment.startPoint.y, selectedSegment.endPoint.y, brakedProgress)

    local travelAngle = selectedSegment.angle
    local cornerAmount = 0.0
    local releaseAmount = 0.0
    local turnDirection = 0.0

    if selectedSegmentProgress < kCornerWindow then
        local cornerExitProgress =
            mt.smoothstep(0.0, kCornerWindow, selectedSegmentProgress)
        travelAngle = interpolateAngle(
            previousSegment.angle,
            selectedSegment.angle,
            0.5 + cornerExitProgress * 0.5
        )
        cornerAmount = 1.0 - cornerExitProgress
        releaseAmount = math.sin(cornerExitProgress * math.pi)
        turnDirection = getTurnDirection(previousSegment.angle, selectedSegment.angle)
    elseif selectedSegmentProgress > 1.0 - kCornerWindow then
        local cornerEntryProgress = mt.smoothstep(
            1.0 - kCornerWindow,
            1.0,
            selectedSegmentProgress
        )
        travelAngle = interpolateAngle(
            selectedSegment.angle,
            nextSegment.angle,
            cornerEntryProgress * 0.5
        )
        cornerAmount = cornerEntryProgress
        turnDirection = getTurnDirection(selectedSegment.angle, nextSegment.angle)
    end

    return {
        positionX = positionX,
        positionY = positionY,
        travelAngle = travelAngle,
        cornerAmount = cornerAmount,
        releaseAmount = releaseAmount,
        turnDirection = turnDirection,
    }
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    ctx.global.shadow.enabled = true
    ctx.global.shadow.distance = kShadowDistance
    ctx.global.shadow.angle = kShadowAngle
    ctx.global.shadow.color = kShadowColor
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local introAmount, outroAmount =
        mt.timeline.intro_outro_seconds(ctx, kIntroDuration, kOutroDuration, kFallbackClipLength)
    local safeCharacterCount = math.max(ctx.char_count, 1)
    local pathSegments, totalPathLength =
        buildPathSegments(kPathPoints, ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio)
    local readingSegment = pathSegments[kReadingSegmentIndex]
    local naturalText = measureNaturalText(ctx)
    local availableReadingWidth =
        math.max(
            readingSegment.length / ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio
                - kReadingEdgePadding * 2.0,
            kTurnEpsilon
        )
    local readingScale = 1.0
    if naturalText.width > availableReadingWidth then
        readingScale = availableReadingWidth / naturalText.width
    end

    local departureStagger = math.min(
        kDepartureStaggerSeconds,
        kMaximumDepartureWaveDuration / math.max(safeCharacterCount - 1, 1)
    )
    local departureWaveDuration =
        math.max(safeCharacterCount - 1, 0) * departureStagger
    local cycleDuration =
        kBottomHoldDuration
            + departureWaveDuration
            + kCircuitDuration
            + kCollectedHoldDuration
    local cycleTime = ctx.time % cycleDuration

    for index, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local geometry = character.geometry
        local characterOrder = mt.distribute(index, safeCharacterCount)

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- Bottom queue: preserve the natural text's horizontal spacing
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local readableSegmentProgress = mt.saturate(
            0.5
                - (geometry.bounds_center_x - naturalText.centerX)
                    * readingScale
                    * ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio
                    / math.max(readingSegment.length, kTurnEpsilon)
        )
        local rawReadableSegmentProgress =
            invertCornerBrake(readableSegmentProgress)
        local readingSlotProgress = (
            readingSegment.cumulativeStart
                + rawReadableSegmentProgress * readingSegment.length
        ) / totalPathLength

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- One-by-one circuit: hold, launch, orbit, collect, hold
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        local departureTime =
            kBottomHoldDuration + (index - 1) * departureStagger
        local travelTime = cycleTime - departureTime
        local circuitProgress = 0.0
        if travelTime >= 0.0 and travelTime < kCircuitDuration then
            local rawCircuitProgress =
                mt.saturate(travelTime / kCircuitDuration)
            circuitProgress = mt.ease.in_out_sine(rawCircuitProgress)
        end

        local pathProgress = readingSlotProgress + circuitProgress
        local pathSample =
            sampleClosedPath(pathSegments, totalPathLength, pathProgress)

        -- For a left turn, the left-hand normal points inside the route;
        -- for a right turn, the right-hand normal does. This cuts the hard
        -- polygon corner without changing the user-authored path points.
        local inwardNormalX =
            -math.sin(pathSample.travelAngle) * pathSample.turnDirection
        local inwardNormalY =
            math.cos(pathSample.travelAngle) * pathSample.turnDirection
        local inwardDistance =
            pathSample.cornerAmount * kCornerCutDistance
                + pathSample.releaseAmount * kCornerReleaseHop
        local naturalVerticalOffset =
            (geometry.bounds_center_y - naturalText.centerY) * readingScale
        local rotatedNaturalOffsetX =
            math.sin(pathSample.travelAngle)
                * naturalVerticalOffset
                / ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio
        local rotatedNaturalOffsetY =
            -math.cos(pathSample.travelAngle) * naturalVerticalOffset
        local targetPositionX = pathSample.positionX
            + inwardNormalX * inwardDistance / ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio
            + rotatedNaturalOffsetX
        local targetPositionY = pathSample.positionY
            + inwardNormalY * inwardDistance
            + rotatedNaturalOffsetY

        local introDelay = characterOrder * 0.28
        local characterIntro = mt.ease.out_back(
            mt.saturate(introAmount * (1.0 + introDelay) - introDelay)
        )
        local outroDelay = (1.0 - characterOrder) * 0.25
        local characterOutro = mt.ease.in_cubic(
            mt.saturate(outroAmount * (1.0 + outroDelay) - outroDelay)
        )

        local cornerCompression =
            pathSample.cornerAmount * kCornerCompression
        local releaseScale =
            pathSample.releaseAmount * kCornerReleaseScale
        -- The bottom edge is the default reading edge: characters are
        -- upright there and arranged left to right while moving clockwise.
        character.rotation = -math.deg(pathSample.travelAngle)
            + kBottomEdgeReadingRotation
            - pathSample.turnDirection * kCornerBankDegrees * pathSample.cornerAmount
        character.scale =
            mt.lerp(kIntroScale * readingScale, readingScale, characterIntro)
                * (1.0 + releaseScale)
        character.stretch_x = 1.0 - cornerCompression
        character.stretch_y = 1.0 + cornerCompression * 0.7

        -- place_2d is called after size and rotation are final, so the
        -- character's true transformed center lands exactly on the route.
        mt.layout.place_2d(
            ctx,
            character,
            targetPositionX,
            targetPositionY
        )

        character.opacity = mt.saturate(characterIntro * 4.0)
            * (1.0 - characterOutro)

        local turnColor =
            mt.color.lerp(kRestColor, kTurnColor, pathSample.cornerAmount)
        character.fill.use = true
        character.fill.color =
            mt.color.lerp(turnColor, kReleaseColor, pathSample.releaseAmount)
        character.stroke.use = true
        character.stroke.width = kStrokeWidth
        character.stroke.gap = 0.0
        character.stroke.color = kStrokeColor
        character.shadow.use = true
        character.shadow.color = mt.color.with_alpha(
            character.fill.color,
            0.28 + pathSample.cornerAmount * 0.3
        )
    end
end

name: 63_ruby_layout.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @duration 5.0
-- @title Ruby Layout
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 2
--[[ @description
Ruby (furigana) auto-layout from HTML markup
("<ruby>親文字<rp>(</rp><rt>ルビ</rt><rp>)</rp></ruby>"). The main text is
retypeset and centered, and each ruby group is fitted above its parent
characters. Line Spacing is repurposed as the ruby/parent gap knob.
]]

local kDefaultText = "ふりがなを<ruby>自動<rp>(</rp><rt>じどう</rt><rp>)</rp></ruby>で<ruby>振<rp>(</rp><rt>ふ</rt><rp>)</rp></ruby>れるようになるんだって！"

-- UTF-8 character splitter helper
local function getUtf8Chars(str)
    local chars = {}
    for code in string.gmatch(str, "[%z\1-\127\194-\244][\128-\191]*") do
        table.insert(chars, code)
    end
    return chars
end

-- Global cache for ruby metadata
local gCharMeta = {}
local gMainIndices = {}
local gRubyGroups = {}

local function parseRubyText(rawInputStr)
    -- Sanitize HTML5 fallback <rp>...</rp> tags first
    local inputStr = string.gsub(rawInputStr, "<rp>.-</rp>", "")

    local plainCharList = {}
    local charMeta = {}
    local mainIndices = {}
    local rubyGroups = {}

    local cursor = 1
    while cursor <= #inputStr do
        local rStart, rEnd, parentStr, rubyStr = string.find(inputStr, "<ruby>(.-)<rt>(.-)</rt></ruby>", cursor)
        if rStart then
            -- Plain text before ruby tag
            if rStart > cursor then
                local plainSub = string.sub(inputStr, cursor, rStart - 1)
                local plainChars = getUtf8Chars(plainSub)
                for _, ch in ipairs(plainChars) do
                    table.insert(plainCharList, ch)
                    local idx = #plainCharList
                    table.insert(mainIndices, idx)
                    table.insert(charMeta, { isRuby = false })
                end
            end

            local pChars = getUtf8Chars(parentStr)
            local rChars = getUtf8Chars(rubyStr)

            -- Parent kanji characters
            local pStartIdx = #plainCharList + 1
            for _, ch in ipairs(pChars) do
                table.insert(plainCharList, ch)
                local idx = #plainCharList
                table.insert(mainIndices, idx)
                table.insert(charMeta, { isRuby = false, isParent = true })
            end
            local pEndIdx = #plainCharList

            -- Ruby furigana characters
            local rIndices = {}
            for i, ch in ipairs(rChars) do
                table.insert(plainCharList, ch)
                local idx = #plainCharList
                table.insert(rIndices, idx)
                table.insert(charMeta, {
                    isRuby = true,
                    parentStart = pStartIdx,
                    parentEnd = pEndIdx,
                    rubyIndex = i,
                    rubyTotal = #rChars,
                })
            end

            table.insert(rubyGroups, {
                parentStart = pStartIdx,
                parentEnd = pEndIdx,
                rubyIndices = rIndices,
            })

            cursor = rEnd + 1
        else
            local restSub = string.sub(inputStr, cursor)
            if #restSub > 0 then
                local restChars = getUtf8Chars(restSub)
                for _, ch in ipairs(restChars) do
                    table.insert(plainCharList, ch)
                    local idx = #plainCharList
                    table.insert(mainIndices, idx)
                    table.insert(charMeta, { isRuby = false })
                end
            end
            break
        end
    end

    local fullPlainText = table.concat(plainCharList, "")
    return fullPlainText, charMeta, mainIndices, rubyGroups
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local rawText = ctx.global.text
    if rawText == nil or rawText == "" then
        rawText = kDefaultText
    end

    local plainText, meta, mainIdx, rubyGrps = parseRubyText(rawText)
    gCharMeta = meta
    gMainIndices = mainIdx
    gRubyGroups = rubyGrps

    -- Materialize plain text
    ctx.global.text = plainText
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local totalChars = ctx.char_count
    if totalChars == 0 then
        return
    end

    -- Line Spacing knob repurposed as the ruby/parent gap.
    -- 1.0 = tuned default gap, 0.0 = flush against the parent.
    local rubyGapKnob = mt.clamp(ctx.global.line_spacing, 0.0, 3.0)

    ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Step 1: Retypeset main body characters & Zero-Drift Center Normalization
    ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    if #gMainIndices > 0 then
        -- Collapse advance width of ruby glyphs so main text flows seamlessly
        for _, group in ipairs(gRubyGroups) do
            for _, rIdx in ipairs(group.rubyIndices) do
                if rIdx <= totalChars then
                    ctx.chars[rIdx].scale = 0.0001
                end
            end
        end

        local firstMainIdx = gMainIndices[1]
        mt.layout.reflow(ctx, 0.0, {
            targets = gMainIndices,
            anchor = firstMainIdx,
        })

        -- Calculate the unrotated 2D center of the main sentence
        local firstGeom = ctx.chars[firstMainIdx].geometry
        local lastMainIdx = gMainIndices[#gMainIndices]
        local lastGeom = ctx.chars[lastMainIdx].geometry

        local firstCenterX = firstGeom.bounds_center_x + (ctx.chars[firstMainIdx].offset_x - 0.5)
        local lastCenterX = lastGeom.bounds_center_x + (ctx.chars[lastMainIdx].offset_x - 0.5)
        local sentenceCenterX = (firstCenterX + lastCenterX) * 0.5

        -- Shift all main characters so the unrotated 2D sentence is centered
        local centerOffset = 0.5 - sentenceCenterX
        for _, mIdx in ipairs(gMainIndices) do
            if mIdx <= totalChars then
                ctx.chars[mIdx].offset_x = ctx.chars[mIdx].offset_x + centerOffset
            end
        end
    end

    ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Step 2: Calculate approximate parent bounds and fit ruby text
    ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Ruby offsets are computed entirely in the parent character's natural/offset
    -- space, without ever touching ctx.global. global.rotation/scale/stretch are
    -- applied once, uniformly, to every character (main and ruby alike) after
    -- OnLayout runs -- so as long as the ruby's offset is expressed in that shared
    -- pre-global space, it automatically rotates and scales together with the
    -- parent character it sits above. Reaching into ctx.global here (as an earlier
    -- version of this sample did, via place_2d's canvas-absolute placement) fights
    -- that shared transform instead of riding along with it.
    for _, group in ipairs(gRubyGroups) do
        local parentFirstGeom = ctx.chars[group.parentStart].geometry
        local parentLastGeom = ctx.chars[group.parentEnd].geometry
        local parentFirstChar = ctx.chars[group.parentStart]
        local parentLastChar = ctx.chars[group.parentEnd]

        -- Parent block center, in natural + offset space (pre-global, canvas-normalized).
        -- Both offset_x/offset_y and bounds_center_x/y are Y-up, 0.5-centered
        -- canvas-normalized values here, so both axes add the same way. (The "-" seen
        -- in prelude.lua's layoutCharacterMatrix, offsetY = -(offset_y - 0.5) * height,
        -- only appears once offset_y is converted into Y-down pixel space -- it is not
        -- present between two values that are both already Y-up, like these two.)
        local parentFirstCenterX = parentFirstGeom.bounds_center_x + (parentFirstChar.offset_x - 0.5)
        local parentLastCenterX = parentLastGeom.bounds_center_x + (parentLastChar.offset_x - 0.5)
        local parentCenterX = (parentFirstCenterX + parentLastCenterX) * 0.5
        local parentCenterY = parentFirstGeom.bounds_center_y + (parentFirstChar.offset_y - 0.5)

        -- Natural (pre-global) block size, matching the naturalRubyGap/minRubySpan tuning
        -- below, which is likewise expressed in this same pre-global canvas-normalized unit.
        local parentBlockWidth =
            (parentLastCenterX - parentFirstCenterX) + (parentFirstGeom.bounds_width * 0.5 + parentLastGeom.bounds_width * 0.5)
        local parentBlockHeight = parentFirstGeom.bounds_height

        local rubyCount = #group.rubyIndices
        local naturalRubyGap = 0.024
        local minRubySpan = 0.012
        local maxRubySpan = math.min(parentBlockWidth * 0.85, math.max(minRubySpan, (rubyCount - 1) * naturalRubyGap))

        for i, rIdx in ipairs(group.rubyIndices) do
            if rIdx <= totalChars then
                local rubyChar = ctx.chars[rIdx]
                local rGeom = rubyChar.geometry

                -- Restore ruby font size (45%)
                rubyChar.scale = 0.45

                -- Lateral offset across the parent block
                local lateralOffset = 0.0
                if rubyCount > 1 then
                    local step = maxRubySpan / (rubyCount - 1)
                    lateralOffset = -(maxRubySpan * 0.5) + (i - 1) * step
                end

                -- Vertical offset (above the parent), in the same pre-global units.
                -- rubyMarginY is scaled by the Line Spacing knob (see OnLayout header).
                local rubyHeight = rGeom.bounds_height * 0.45
                local rubyMarginY = 0.008 * rubyGapKnob
                local verticalOffset = (parentBlockHeight * 0.5) + (rubyHeight * 0.5) + rubyMarginY

                local targetCenterX = parentCenterX + lateralOffset
                local targetCenterY = parentCenterY + verticalOffset

                -- Move the ruby's own natural center to the target by adjusting its offset
                -- directly, staying in the same pre-global space as targetCenterX/Y above
                -- (both axes add the same way here; see the note above parentCenterY).
                rubyChar.offset_x = 0.5 + targetCenterX - rGeom.bounds_center_x
                rubyChar.offset_y = 0.5 + targetCenterY - rGeom.bounds_center_y
            end
        end
    end
end

Ruby (furigana) auto-layout from HTML markup

characters. Line Spacing is repurposed as the ruby/parent gap knob.

source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @title Bounce Ground Drop
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 6
--[[ @description
Ground bounce drop. Characters fall onto a fixed canvas ground plane
and bounce to a settle, driven by the mt.bounce_ground helper.
]]

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local groundY = 0.15 -- Ground plane Canvas position

    for i, char in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        -- Bounce character towards ground plane
        -- start_mode options:
        --   "absolute": Every character falls from the same canvas height (start_y)
        --   "relative": Each character falls from drop_height above its own laid-out position
        -- ground_mode options (defaults to start_mode):
        --   "absolute": groundY is a fixed canvas line, immune to global rotation / scale
        --   "relative": the landing follows the ancestor transforms
        -- align_to options:
        --   "bottom": Aligns character lower ink-bounds edge on ground plane (physical collision, default)
        --   "baseline": Aligns character baseline / typesetting origin on ground plane
        --   "center": Aligns character center on ground plane
        mt.bounce_ground(ctx, char, groundY, {
            start_mode = "absolute",
            start_y = 0.75,
            ground_mode = "absolute",
            delay = (i - 1) * 0.1,
            align_to = "bottom", -- "bottom" or "baseline"
            gravity = 5.0,
            restitution = 0.5,
            squash = 0.2,
            stretch = 0.03,
            flexibility = 18.0,
            damping = 6.0
        })
    end
end

-- @MugTypography
-- @title Bounce Relative Settle
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 6
--[[ @description
Relative bounce settle. Each character drops from a fixed distance above
its own laid-out position, so any layout keeps its shape and every
character settles back exactly where it was typeset.
]]

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local dropHeight = 0.35
    local waveAmplitude = 0.08
    local waveFrequency = 0.9

    for i, char in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        -- Give the line a wavy resting shape first. bounce_ground reads this
        -- laid-out position, so the drop origin follows the wave per character.
        local phase = mt.distribute(i, #ctx.chars)
        char.offset_y = char.offset_y + math.sin(phase * math.pi * 2.0 * waveFrequency) * waveAmplitude

        -- Each character lands on its own wave position rather than a shared
        -- ground line, because the ground plane is derived per character.
        local _, restY = mt.layout.get_canvas_position_2d(ctx, char)

        mt.bounce_ground(ctx, char, restY, {
            start_mode = "relative",
            drop_height = dropHeight,
            delay = (i - 1) * 0.08,
            align_to = "center",
            gravity = 5.0,
            restitution = 0.45,
            squash = 0.22,
            stretch = 0.035,
            flexibility = 18.0,
            damping = 6.5
        })
    end
end

source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @duration 6.0
-- @title Debris Burst
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 6
--[[ @description
Debris burst. A shockwave expands from the centre of the canvas, lifting
each character as the crest passes it, then throwing that character's
parts outward on spinning ballistic arcs.
]]

local kWaveSpeed = 0.45 -- canvas units per second
local kCrestRadius = 0.18 -- width of the shockwave crest
local kCrestLift = 0.07 -- how far the crest lifts a character
local kCrestShove = 0.04 -- how far the crest pushes a character away from the centre
local kBurstDelay = 0.35 -- seconds between the crest passing and the parts letting go
local kBurstSpeed = 0.55 -- launch speed of a thrown part
local kBurstGravity = 1.6
local kBurstSpin = 420.0 -- max spin rate, degrees per second
local kFadeDuration = 1.4

function OnLayout(ctx)
    local seed = ctx.meta.instance_seed
    local waveFront = ctx.time * kWaveSpeed

    for _, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        local geometry = character.geometry

        -- Distance is aspect corrected, so the shockwave reads as a circle even
        -- on a wide comp. Without the correction it would flatten into an ellipse.
        local radius =
            mt.layout.radial_distance(ctx, geometry.bounds_center_x, geometry.bounds_center_y)

        -- The crest is a smooth band around the wave front. falloff keeps the
        -- leading and trailing edges continuous as the band sweeps outward.
        local crest = mt.falloff(radius - waveFront, kCrestRadius)

        -- Push the character away from the centre while the crest passes, so the
        -- shockwave shoves outward rather than only lifting.
        local outwardAngle = math.deg(math.atan(
            (geometry.bounds_center_y - 0.5) * -1.0, (geometry.bounds_center_x - 0.5)))
        local shoveX, shoveY = mt.polar_offset_2d(outwardAngle, crest * kCrestShove)
        character.offset_x = character.offset_x + shoveX
        character.offset_y = character.offset_y + shoveY + crest * kCrestLift

        local sinceArrival = ctx.time - (radius / kWaveSpeed) - kBurstDelay
        if sinceArrival > 0.0 then
            character.opacity = mt.saturate(1.0 - sinceArrival / kFadeDuration)
        end
    end

    for index, part in mt.each_part(ctx) do
        local character = ctx.chars[part.character_index]
        local geometry = character.geometry
        local radius =
            mt.layout.radial_distance(ctx, geometry.bounds_center_x, geometry.bounds_center_y)

        local sinceArrival = ctx.time - (radius / kWaveSpeed) - kBurstDelay
        if sinceArrival > 0.0 then
            -- Throw each part away from the canvas centre, with a little spread
            -- so the debris does not travel in perfect lockstep.
            local awayX = geometry.bounds_center_x - 0.5
            local awayY = geometry.bounds_center_y - 0.5
            local spreadAngle = mt.random_range(seed, index, -35.0, 35.0)
            -- Screen orientation: negative Y is up, so bias the throw upward.
            local throwAngle = -90.0 + spreadAngle + awayX * 90.0 - awayY * 20.0

            local flight = mt.projectile_2d({
                t = sinceArrival,
                speed = kBurstSpeed * mt.random_range(seed, index + 1000, 0.7, 1.3),
                angle = throwAngle,
                gravity = kBurstGravity,
                spin = mt.random_range(seed, index + 2000, -kBurstSpin, kBurstSpin),
            })

            part.offset_x = part.offset_x + flight.x
            part.offset_y = part.offset_y + flight.y
            part.rotation = part.rotation + flight.rotation
        end
    end
end
description:
Debris burst. A shockwave expands from the centre of the canvas, lifting
each character as the crest passes it, then throwing that character's
parts outward on spinning ballistic arcs.
title: Debris Burst
author: Mug

name: 69_mobius_transmission.lua
source:
-- @MugTypography
-- @duration 11.0
-- @required 3d
-- @recommend text "ENDLESS-SIGNAL"
-- @recommend bg #03030A
-- @title Mobius Transmission
-- @author Mug
-- @version 1.0
-- @api_level 6
--[[ @description
Mobius transmission. Luminous fragments spiral in from deep space and
lock into a one-sided receiver. A signal circles the completed loop,
lingers, then decodes into readable text through an invisible edge-on
exchange. Sparse block interference interrupts the held message before
it fractures into light needles and escapes into depth.
]]

local kFallbackClipLength = 11.0
local kArrivalDuration = 1.35
local kArrivalStaggerSpan = 0.55
local kArrivalDepth = 0.85
local kArrivalArcDegrees = 220.0
local kArrivalRadialDistance = 0.48
local kPulseStart =
    kArrivalDuration + kArrivalStaggerSpan + 0.05
local kPulsePeriod = 1.8
local kPulseAfterglowDuration = 0.35
local kPulsePauseDuration = 0.55
local kIntroStart =
    kPulseStart +
    kPulsePeriod +
    kPulseAfterglowDuration +
    kPulsePauseDuration
local kIntroDuration = 1.3
local kIntroStaggerSpan = 0.45
local kIntroScaleSettleDuration = 0.8
local kIntroFadeDuration = 0.32
local kMinimumTextHoldDuration = 1.7
local kOutroLeadTime = 2.15
local kOutroDuration = 1.15
local kOutroStaggerSpan = 0.42
local kOutroFadeDuration = 0.48

local kLoopCenterX = 0.5
local kLoopCenterY = 0.5
local kLoopRadius = 0.275
local kLeafLengthUnits = 1320.0
local kLeafHalfWidthUnits = 172.0
local kLeafOverlap = 1.08
local kLeafVeinGapRatio = 0.065
local kLeafCenterSkewRatio = 0.1
local kLeafUpperFullness = 0.96
local kLeafLowerFullness = 0.82
local kLeafFullnessVariation = 0.08
local kLeafUpperTrailingControlRatio = 0.58
local kLeafUpperLeadingControlRatio = 0.2
local kLeafUpperTrailingHeightRatio = 0.82
local kLeafLowerTrailingControlRatio = 0.52
local kLeafLowerLeadingControlRatio = 0.28
local kLeafLowerTrailingHeightRatio = 0.68
local kLeafVeinTrailingControlRatio = 0.42
local kLeafVeinLeadingControlRatio = 0.36
local kLeafVeinControlHeightRatio = 0.26
local kPathUnitsPerEm = 1000.0
local kMinimumLeafScale = 0.28
local kMaximumLeafScale = 1.35
local kMinimumScale = 0.0001
local kEdgeOnYaw = 90.0
local kHalfTurnDegrees = 180.0
local kFullTurnDegrees = 360.0

local kPulseRadius = 0.105
local kPulseTrailOffset = 0.13
local kPulseTrailRadius = 0.18
local kPulseTrailStrength = 0.38
local kPulseWidthBoost = 0.42
local kPulseDepthLift = 0.035
local kIdleBreathAmount = 0.018
local kIdleBreathFrequency = 0.21
local kShardLengthUnits = 1180.0
local kShardHalfWidthUnits = 72.0
local kShardLaunchDistance = 0.52
local kShardDepth = 0.72
local kShardPositionFanDegrees = 22.0
local kShardDirectionJitterDegrees = 35.0
local kShardMinimumSpeedScale = 0.76
local kShardMaximumSpeedScale = 1.28
local kShardDirectionSeedOffset = 113
local kShardSpeedSeedOffset = 197
local kShardTailEndRatio = 0.62
local kShardShoulderRatio = 0.18
local kShardTailNotchUnits = 115.0
local kShardAfterimageLengthUnits = 220.0
local kShardAfterimageCount = 2
local kShardAfterimageLengthDecay = 0.72
local kShardAfterimageBaseGapUnits = 90.0
local kShardAfterimageTravelGapUnits = 150.0
local kShardAfterimageHeightRatio = 0.28
local kShardAfterimageVerticalOffsetRatio = 0.42
local kShardAfterimageSlantUnits = 32.0
local kGlitchPulseCount = 3
local kGlitchPulseSpacing = 0.105
local kGlitchPulseDuration = 0.09
local kGlitchFalloffRadiusRatio = 0.42
local kGlitchBurstPeriod = 0.94
local kGlitchTimingJitter = 0.028
local kGlitchActivationChance = 0.42
local kGlitchMinimumStrength = 0.68
local kGlitchCharacterSeedStride = 4099
local kGlitchEventSeedStride = 131
local kGlitchTimingSeedOffset = 17
local kGlitchActivationSeedOffset = 43
local kGlitchStrengthSeedOffset = 79
local kGlitchBlockCount = 5
local kGlitchBlockHeightUnits = 96.0
local kGlitchBlockVerticalStepUnits = 155.0
local kGlitchBlockBaseWidthUnits = 300.0
local kGlitchBlockWidthStepUnits = 90.0
local kGlitchOffset = 0.008

local kCameraPerspective = 0.28
local kCameraYawAmplitude = 13.0
local kCameraPitch = 8.0
local kCameraZoom = 1.04

local kPearlColor = { r = 0.82, g = 0.87, b = 0.96, a = 1.0 }
local kLeafColor = { r = 0.12, g = 0.32, b = 0.72, a = 1.0 }
local kPulseColor = { r = 0.68, g = 1.0, b = 0.94, a = 1.0 }
local kGlitchColorA = { r = 0.2, g = 0.95, b = 1.0, a = 1.0 }
local kGlitchColorB = { r = 1.0, g = 0.22, b = 0.74, a = 1.0 }
local kEdgeColor = { r = 0.04, g = 0.08, b = 0.22, a = 0.96 }
local kStrokeWidth = 0.008

local kPathModeLeaf = "leaf"
local kPathModeShard = "shard"
local kPathModeGlitch = "glitch"

local cachedPathMode = {}
local cachedPathWidth = {}
local cachedPathBend = {}
local cachedPathProgress = {}

local function getOutroStart(ctx)
    return math.max(
        kIntroStart + kIntroDuration + kIntroStaggerSpan +
            kMinimumTextHoldDuration,
        mt.timeline.duration(ctx, kFallbackClipLength) - kOutroLeadTime)
end

local function getCircularDistance(firstPosition, secondPosition)
    local directDistance = math.abs(firstPosition - secondPosition)
    return math.min(directDistance, 1.0 - directDistance)
end

local function getStaggerProgress(
        time,
        ordinal,
        characterCount,
        pattern,
        totalSpan,
        duration)
    local perCharacterDelay =
        totalSpan / math.max(characterCount - 1, 1)
    local progress = mt.stagger_pattern(
        time,
        ordinal,
        characterCount,
        pattern,
        perCharacterDelay,
        duration)
    return mt.smoothstep(
        0.0,
        1.0,
        progress)
end

local function getGlitchEvent(ctx, ordinal, outroStart)
    local textHoldStart =
        kIntroStart + kIntroDuration + kIntroStaggerSpan + 0.18
    local textHoldEnd = outroStart - 0.22
    local glitchAmount = 0.0
    local glitchEventIndex = 0

    if ctx.time >= textHoldStart and ctx.time < textHoldEnd then
        local rhythmTime = ctx.time - textHoldStart
        local currentBurstIndex =
            math.floor(rhythmTime / kGlitchBurstPeriod)

        for burstOffset = -1, 1 do
            local burstIndex = currentBurstIndex + burstOffset
            if burstIndex >= 0 then
                for pulseIndex = 0, kGlitchPulseCount - 1 do
                    local eventIndex =
                        burstIndex * kGlitchPulseCount + pulseIndex
                    local randomIndex =
                        ordinal * kGlitchCharacterSeedStride +
                        eventIndex * kGlitchEventSeedStride
                    local selectedCharacter =
                        mt.random(
                            ctx.meta.instance_seed +
                                kGlitchActivationSeedOffset,
                            randomIndex) < kGlitchActivationChance

                    if selectedCharacter then
                        local timingOffset =
                            mt.random_range(
                                ctx.meta.instance_seed +
                                    kGlitchTimingSeedOffset,
                                randomIndex,
                                -kGlitchTimingJitter,
                                kGlitchTimingJitter)
                        local eventTime =
                            textHoldStart +
                            burstIndex * kGlitchBurstPeriod +
                            pulseIndex * kGlitchPulseSpacing +
                            timingOffset
                        local eventDistance =
                            math.abs(ctx.time - eventTime)

                        if eventDistance <=
                            kGlitchPulseDuration * 0.5 then
                            local eventStrength =
                                mt.random_range(
                                    ctx.meta.instance_seed +
                                        kGlitchStrengthSeedOffset,
                                    randomIndex,
                                    kGlitchMinimumStrength,
                                    1.0)
                            local candidateAmount =
                                mt.falloff(
                                    eventDistance,
                                    kGlitchPulseDuration *
                                        kGlitchFalloffRadiusRatio) *
                                eventStrength
                            if candidateAmount > glitchAmount then
                                glitchAmount = candidateAmount
                                glitchEventIndex = eventIndex + 1
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return glitchAmount, glitchEventIndex
end

local function getFoldTransforms(segmentState, targetRotation, targetPitch)
    local yaw = 0.0
    local rotation = 0.0
    local pitch = 0.0

    if segmentState < 0.5 then
        local foldProgress = mt.smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, segmentState * 2.0)
        yaw = mt.lerp(0.0, kEdgeOnYaw, foldProgress)
    else
        local unfoldProgress =
            mt.smoothstep(
                0.0,
                1.0,
                (segmentState - 0.5) * 2.0)
        yaw = mt.lerp(kEdgeOnYaw, 0.0, unfoldProgress)
        rotation = targetRotation * unfoldProgress
        pitch = targetPitch * unfoldProgress
    end

    return yaw, rotation, pitch
end

function OnPreLayout(ctx)
    local clipLength = mt.timeline.duration(ctx, kFallbackClipLength)
    local inspectorGlobalScale = ctx.global.scale
    local introScaleReleaseStart =
        kIntroStart + kIntroStaggerSpan + kIntroDuration * 0.5
    local introScaleReleaseEnd =
        kIntroStart +
        kIntroDuration +
        kIntroStaggerSpan +
        kIntroScaleSettleDuration
    local introScaleReleaseProgress = mt.saturate(
        mt.inverse_lerp(
            introScaleReleaseStart,
            introScaleReleaseEnd,
            ctx.time))
    local introScaleLock =
        1.0 - mt.ease.out_cubic(introScaleReleaseProgress)
    local introCompletion =
        mt.smoothstep(
            kIntroStart,
            kIntroStart +
                kIntroDuration +
                kIntroStaggerSpan,
            ctx.time)
    local introLoopPresence = 1.0 - introCompletion
    local outroStart = getOutroStart(ctx)
    local outroScaleLockStart =
        outroStart + kOutroStaggerSpan + kOutroDuration * 0.5
    local outroScaleLockEnd =
        outroStart + kOutroStaggerSpan + kOutroDuration
    local outroScaleLock = mt.smoothstep(
        outroScaleLockStart,
        outroScaleLockEnd,
        ctx.time)
    local generatedScaleLock =
        math.max(introScaleLock, outroScaleLock)
    local outroPresence =
        mt.smoothstep(
            outroStart,
            outroStart +
                kOutroDuration +
                kOutroStaggerSpan,
            ctx.time)
    local introVisibility =
        mt.smoothstep(0.0, kIntroFadeDuration, ctx.time)
    local outroVisibility = 1.0 - mt.smoothstep(
        clipLength - kOutroFadeDuration,
        clipLength,
        ctx.time)

    ctx.camera.yaw =
        mt.wave(ctx.time, 0.115, 0.0) *
            kCameraYawAmplitude * introLoopPresence -
        outroPresence * 7.0
    ctx.camera.pitch =
        kCameraPitch * introLoopPresence - outroPresence * 4.0
    ctx.camera.perspective =
        kCameraPerspective * math.max(introLoopPresence, outroPresence)
    ctx.camera.zoom =
        mt.lerp(1.0, kCameraZoom, introLoopPresence) -
        outroPresence * 0.06
    ctx.global.scale =
        mt.lerp(inspectorGlobalScale, 1.0, generatedScaleLock)
    ctx.global.opacity =
        ctx.global.opacity * introVisibility * outroVisibility
end

function OnLayout(ctx)
    cachedPathMode = {}
    cachedPathWidth = {}
    cachedPathBend = {}
    cachedPathProgress = {}

    local leafCharacterCount = 0
    local ordinalByCharacter = {}
    for characterIndex, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
        if character.part_count > 0 then
            leafCharacterCount = leafCharacterCount + 1
            ordinalByCharacter[characterIndex] = leafCharacterCount
        end
    end

    local emCanvasHeight = math.max(
        ctx.font.ascent + ctx.font.descent,
        0.001)
    local angleStep = kFullTurnDegrees / math.max(leafCharacterCount, 1)
    local chordLength =
        2.0 * kLoopRadius *
        math.sin(math.rad(angleStep) * 0.5) *
        kLeafOverlap
    local targetLeafScale = mt.clamp(
        chordLength / (emCanvasHeight * kLeafLengthUnits / kPathUnitsPerEm),
        kMinimumLeafScale,
        kMaximumLeafScale)
    local pulseProgress = mt.saturate(
        mt.inverse_lerp(
            kPulseStart,
            kPulseStart + kPulsePeriod,
            ctx.time))
    local pulseVisibility =
        mt.smoothstep(kPulseStart, kPulseStart + 0.12, ctx.time) *
        (1.0 - mt.smoothstep(
            kPulseStart + kPulsePeriod,
            kPulseStart + kPulsePeriod +
                kPulseAfterglowDuration,
            ctx.time))
    local pulsePosition = pulseProgress
    local pulseTrailPosition =
        mt.cycle(pulsePosition - kPulseTrailOffset, 1.0)
    local breathingRadius =
        kLoopRadius *
        (1.0 + mt.wave(ctx.time, kIdleBreathFrequency, 0.0) * kIdleBreathAmount)
    local outroStart = getOutroStart(ctx)

    for characterIndex, character in mt.each_char(ctx) do
            local ordinal = ordinalByCharacter[characterIndex]

        if ordinal ~= nil then
            local distributedPosition =
                (ordinal - 1.0) / math.max(leafCharacterCount, 1)
            local angleDegrees = distributedPosition * kFullTurnDegrees
            local introLeafState =
                1.0 - getStaggerProgress(
                    ctx.time - kIntroStart,
                    ordinal,
                    leafCharacterCount,
                    "asc",
                    kIntroStaggerSpan,
                    kIntroDuration)
            local outroState =
                getStaggerProgress(
                    ctx.time - outroStart,
                    ordinal,
                    leafCharacterCount,
                    "desc",
                    kOutroStaggerSpan,
                    kOutroDuration)
            local arrivalProgress =
                getStaggerProgress(
                    ctx.time,
                    ordinal,
                    leafCharacterCount,
                    "asc",
                    kArrivalStaggerSpan,
                    kArrivalDuration)
            local naturalCanvasX, naturalCanvasY =
                mt.layout.get_canvas_position_2d(ctx, character)
            local pulseDistance =
                getCircularDistance(distributedPosition, pulsePosition)
            local pulseTrailDistance =
                getCircularDistance(
                    distributedPosition,
                    pulseTrailPosition)
            local pulseAmount = mt.saturate(
                mt.falloff(pulseDistance, kPulseRadius) +
                mt.falloff(pulseTrailDistance, kPulseTrailRadius) *
                    kPulseTrailStrength)
            local placedCanvasX = naturalCanvasX
            local placedCanvasY = naturalCanvasY
            local pathMode = nil
            local pathWidth = kLeafHalfWidthUnits
            local pathBend = 0.0
            local pathProgress = 0.0
            local color = kPearlColor
            local strokeColor = kEdgeColor

            if outroState > 0.0 then
                local launchProgress = mt.smoothstep(
                    0.5,
                    1.0,
                    outroState)
                local directionJitter =
                    mt.random_range(
                        ctx.meta.instance_seed +
                            kShardDirectionSeedOffset,
                        ordinal,
                        -kShardDirectionJitterDegrees,
                        kShardDirectionJitterDegrees)
                local speedScale =
                    mt.random_range(
                        ctx.meta.instance_seed +
                            kShardSpeedSeedOffset,
                        ordinal,
                        kShardMinimumSpeedScale,
                        kShardMaximumSpeedScale)
                local launchAngle =
                    -90.0 +
                    (distributedPosition - 0.5) *
                        kShardPositionFanDegrees +
                    directionJitter
                local launchDistance =
                    launchProgress *
                    kShardLaunchDistance *
                    speedScale
                local launchOffsetX, launchOffsetY =
                    mt.polar_offset_2d(
                        launchAngle,
                        launchDistance)
                placedCanvasX = naturalCanvasX + launchOffsetX
                placedCanvasY = naturalCanvasY + launchOffsetY

                local yaw, rotation, pitch =
                    getFoldTransforms(
                        outroState,
                        launchAngle,
                        -28.0 + distributedPosition * 56.0)
                character.yaw = character.yaw + yaw
                character.rotation =
                    character.rotation +
                    rotation
                character.pitch = character.pitch + pitch
                character.z =
                    character.z +
                    launchProgress *
                        kShardDepth *
                        speedScale
                character.scale =
                    character.scale * mt.lerp(1.0, 0.58, launchProgress)
                if outroState >= 0.5 then
                    character.scale =
                        character.scale /
                        math.max(ctx.global.scale, kMinimumScale)
                end
                character.opacity =
                    character.opacity *
                    (1.0 - mt.smoothstep(0.72, 1.0, outroState))

                local shardPulse =
                    mt.falloff(outroState - 0.58, 0.16)
                color =
                    mt.color.lerp(kPearlColor, kPulseColor, shardPulse)
                strokeColor =
                    mt.color.lerp(kEdgeColor, kPulseColor, shardPulse)
                pathMode =
                    outroState >= 0.5 and kPathModeShard or nil
                pathWidth =
                    kShardHalfWidthUnits * (1.0 + shardPulse * 0.7)
                pathBend =
                    (distributedPosition - 0.5) * 0.3
                pathProgress =
                    mt.saturate(launchProgress * speedScale)
            else
                local arrivalAngleDegrees =
                    angleDegrees -
                    (1.0 - arrivalProgress) * kArrivalArcDegrees
                local arrivalAngleRadians =
                    math.rad(arrivalAngleDegrees)
                local arrivalRadius =
                    breathingRadius +
                    (1.0 - arrivalProgress) *
                        kArrivalRadialDistance
                local arrivalCanvasX =
                    kLoopCenterX +
                    math.cos(arrivalAngleRadians) * arrivalRadius /
                        (ctx.canvas.aspect_ratio *
                            ctx.canvas.pixel_aspect_ratio)
                local arrivalCanvasY =
                    kLoopCenterY +
                    math.sin(arrivalAngleRadians) * arrivalRadius
                placedCanvasX =
                    mt.lerp(
                        naturalCanvasX,
                        arrivalCanvasX,
                        introLeafState)
                placedCanvasY =
                    mt.lerp(
                        naturalCanvasY,
                        arrivalCanvasY,
                        introLeafState)

                local targetRotation =
                    -(arrivalAngleDegrees + 90.0)
                local targetPitch =
                    distributedPosition * kHalfTurnDegrees -
                    (1.0 - arrivalProgress) *
                        kArrivalArcDegrees * 0.5
                local yaw, rotation, pitch =
                    getFoldTransforms(
                        introLeafState,
                        targetRotation,
                        targetPitch)
                character.yaw = character.yaw + yaw
                character.rotation =
                    character.rotation + rotation
                character.pitch = character.pitch + pitch
                character.z =
                    character.z +
                    (1.0 - arrivalProgress) *
                        kArrivalDepth *
                        introLeafState
                character.scale =
                    character.scale *
                    mt.lerp(
                        1.0,
                        targetLeafScale,
                        introLeafState) *
                    mt.lerp(0.32, 1.0, arrivalProgress)
                character.opacity =
                    character.opacity *
                    mt.smoothstep(0.0, 0.45, arrivalProgress)

                local visiblePulse =
                    pulseAmount *
                    pulseVisibility *
                    introLeafState *
                    arrivalProgress
                character.z =
                    character.z - visiblePulse * kPulseDepthLift
                color = mt.color.lerp(
                    mt.color.lerp(
                        kPearlColor,
                        kLeafColor,
                        introLeafState),
                    kPulseColor,
                    visiblePulse)
                strokeColor =
                    mt.color.lerp(
                        kEdgeColor,
                        kPulseColor,
                        visiblePulse * 0.7)
                pathMode =
                    introLeafState >= 0.5 and kPathModeLeaf or nil
                pathWidth =
                    kLeafHalfWidthUnits *
                    (1.0 + visiblePulse * kPulseWidthBoost)
                pathBend =
                    mt.wave(ctx.time, 0.38, distributedPosition) *
                    (0.08 + visiblePulse * 0.14)

                local glitchAmount, glitchEventIndex =
                    getGlitchEvent(ctx, ordinal, outroStart)
                if introLeafState < 0.5 and
                    glitchEventIndex > 0 then
                    local glitchDirection =
                        (ordinal + glitchEventIndex) % 2 == 0 and
                        1.0 or -1.0
                    placedCanvasX =
                        placedCanvasX +
                        glitchDirection *
                            kGlitchOffset * glitchAmount
                    placedCanvasY =
                        placedCanvasY +
                        ((glitchEventIndex - 1) %
                            kGlitchPulseCount - 1.0) *
                            kGlitchOffset * 0.35 *
                            glitchAmount
                    character.stretch_x =
                        character.stretch_x *
                        (1.0 + glitchAmount * 0.18)
                    character.stretch_y =
                        character.stretch_y *
                        (1.0 - glitchAmount * 0.12)
                    color = mt.color.lerp(
                        kPearlColor,
                        glitchEventIndex % 2 == 0 and
                            kGlitchColorA or kGlitchColorB,
                        glitchAmount)
                    strokeColor =
                        mt.color.lerp(
                            kEdgeColor,
                            kPulseColor,
                            glitchAmount)
                    pathMode = kPathModeGlitch
                    pathWidth = glitchAmount
                    pathBend = glitchEventIndex
                end
            end

            mt.layout.place_2d(
                ctx,
                character,
                placedCanvasX,
                placedCanvasY)

            if pathMode ~= nil then
                local firstPart = ctx.parts[character.part_start]
                if firstPart ~= nil then
                    mt.layout.place_2d(
                        ctx,
                        firstPart,
                        placedCanvasX,
                        placedCanvasY)
                end
            end

            character.fill.use = true
            character.fill.color = color
            character.stroke.use = true
            character.stroke.width = kStrokeWidth
            character.stroke.gap = 0.0
            character.stroke.color = strokeColor

            cachedPathMode[characterIndex] = pathMode
            cachedPathWidth[characterIndex] = pathWidth
            cachedPathBend[characterIndex] = pathBend
            cachedPathProgress[characterIndex] = pathProgress
        end
    end
end

local function appendLeafPath(path, characterIndex, halfWidth, bend)
    local halfLength = kLeafLengthUnits * 0.5
    local leafDirection =
        characterIndex % 2 == 0 and -1.0 or 1.0
    local centerY =
        halfWidth * kLeafCenterSkewRatio * leafDirection
    local veinGap = halfWidth * kLeafVeinGapRatio
    local upperWidth =
        halfWidth *
        (kLeafUpperFullness -
            leafDirection * kLeafFullnessVariation) *
        (1.0 + bend)
    local lowerWidth =
        halfWidth *
        (kLeafLowerFullness +
            leafDirection * kLeafFullnessVariation) *
        (1.0 - bend)

    path:move_to(-halfLength, centerY - veinGap)
    path:cubic_to(
        -halfLength * kLeafUpperTrailingControlRatio,
        centerY - upperWidth * kLeafUpperTrailingHeightRatio,
        halfLength * kLeafUpperLeadingControlRatio,
        centerY - upperWidth,
        halfLength,
        centerY)
    path:cubic_to(
        halfLength * kLeafVeinLeadingControlRatio,
        centerY - veinGap * kLeafVeinControlHeightRatio,
        -halfLength * kLeafVeinTrailingControlRatio,
        centerY - veinGap * kLeafVeinControlHeightRatio,
        -halfLength,
        centerY - veinGap)
    path:close()

    path:move_to(-halfLength, centerY + veinGap)
    path:cubic_to(
        -halfLength * kLeafLowerTrailingControlRatio,
        centerY + lowerWidth * kLeafLowerTrailingHeightRatio,
        halfLength * kLeafLowerLeadingControlRatio,
        centerY + lowerWidth,
        halfLength,
        centerY)
    path:cubic_to(
        halfLength * kLeafVeinLeadingControlRatio,
        centerY + veinGap * kLeafVeinControlHeightRatio,
        -halfLength * kLeafVeinTrailingControlRatio,
        centerY + veinGap * kLeafVeinControlHeightRatio,
        -halfLength,
        centerY + veinGap)
    path:close()
end

local function appendShardPath(path, halfWidth, bend, progress)
    local halfLength = kShardLengthUnits * 0.5
    local noseX = halfLength
    local shoulderX = halfLength * kShardShoulderRatio
    local tailEndX = -halfLength * kShardTailEndRatio
    local tailCenterY = bend * halfWidth
    local tailHalfWidth = halfWidth * 0.36

    path:move_to(noseX, 0.0)
    path:cubic_to(
        shoulderX,
        -halfWidth,
        -shoulderX,
        -halfWidth * 0.72,
        tailEndX,
        tailCenterY - tailHalfWidth)
    path:line_to(
        tailEndX + kShardTailNotchUnits,
        tailCenterY)
    path:line_to(tailEndX, tailCenterY + tailHalfWidth)
    path:cubic_to(
        -shoulderX,
        halfWidth * 0.72,
        shoulderX,
        halfWidth,
        noseX,
        0.0)
    path:close()

    local afterimageGap =
        kShardAfterimageBaseGapUnits +
        progress * kShardAfterimageTravelGapUnits
    local previousLeftX = tailEndX
    for afterimageIndex = 1, kShardAfterimageCount do
        local afterimageLength =
            kShardAfterimageLengthUnits *
            kShardAfterimageLengthDecay ^ (afterimageIndex - 1)
        local afterimageRightX = previousLeftX - afterimageGap
        local afterimageLeftX =
            afterimageRightX - afterimageLength
        local verticalDirection =
            afterimageIndex % 2 == 0 and -1.0 or 1.0
        local afterimageCenterY =
            tailCenterY +
            verticalDirection *
                halfWidth *
                kShardAfterimageVerticalOffsetRatio
        local afterimageHalfHeight =
            halfWidth * kShardAfterimageHeightRatio
        local afterimageSlant =
            kShardAfterimageSlantUnits * verticalDirection

        path:move_to(
            afterimageLeftX - afterimageSlant,
            afterimageCenterY - afterimageHalfHeight)
        path:line_to(
            afterimageRightX - afterimageSlant,
            afterimageCenterY - afterimageHalfHeight)
        path:line_to(
            afterimageRightX + afterimageSlant,
            afterimageCenterY + afterimageHalfHeight)
        path:line_to(
            afterimageLeftX + afterimageSlant,
            afterimageCenterY + afterimageHalfHeight)
        path:close()
        previousLeftX = afterimageLeftX
    end
end

local function appendGlitchPath(
        path,
        characterIndex,
        glitchAmount,
        glitchEventIndex)
    for blockIndex = 1, kGlitchBlockCount do
        local widthStep =
            (characterIndex * 3 +
                blockIndex * 2 +
                glitchEventIndex) % 4
        local blockWidth =
            kGlitchBlockBaseWidthUnits +
            widthStep * kGlitchBlockWidthStepUnits
        local blockHalfWidth = blockWidth * 0.5
        local blockHalfHeight =
            kGlitchBlockHeightUnits *
            (0.7 + glitchAmount * 0.3) * 0.5
        local blockCenterX =
            math.sin(
                characterIndex * 1.7 +
                blockIndex * 2.1 +
                glitchEventIndex) *
            170.0 * glitchAmount
        local blockCenterY =
            (blockIndex -
                (kGlitchBlockCount + 1.0) * 0.5) *
            kGlitchBlockVerticalStepUnits

        path:move_to(
            blockCenterX - blockHalfWidth,
            blockCenterY - blockHalfHeight)
        path:line_to(
            blockCenterX + blockHalfWidth,
            blockCenterY - blockHalfHeight)
        path:line_to(
            blockCenterX + blockHalfWidth,
            blockCenterY + blockHalfHeight)
        path:line_to(
            blockCenterX - blockHalfWidth,
            blockCenterY + blockHalfHeight)
        path:close()
    end
end

function OnPath(ctx)
    for characterIndex = 1, ctx.char_count do
        local pathMode = cachedPathMode[characterIndex]
        if pathMode ~= nil then
            local pathParts = ctx.paths:character(characterIndex)

            if #pathParts > 0 then
                local halfWidth =
                    cachedPathWidth[characterIndex] or kLeafHalfWidthUnits
                local bend = cachedPathBend[characterIndex] or 0.0
                local pathProgress =
                    cachedPathProgress[characterIndex] or 0.0
                local generatedPath = pathParts[1].path

                generatedPath:clear()
                if pathMode == kPathModeLeaf then
                    appendLeafPath(
                        generatedPath,
                        characterIndex,
                        halfWidth,
                        bend)
                elseif pathMode == kPathModeShard then
                    appendShardPath(
                        generatedPath,
                        halfWidth,
                        bend,
                        pathProgress)
                elseif pathMode == kPathModeGlitch then
                    appendGlitchPath(
                        generatedPath,
                        characterIndex,
                        halfWidth,
                        math.floor(bend))
                end

                for partIndex = 2, #pathParts do
                    pathParts[partIndex].path:clear()
                end
            end
        end
    end
end
description:
Mobius transmission. Luminous fragments spiral in from deep space and
lock into a one-sided receiver. A signal circles the completed loop,
lingers, then decodes into readable text through an invisible edge-on
exchange. Sparse block interference interrupts the held message before
it fractures into light needles and escapes into depth.
